title: Associate Specialist - Quality Engineering (Veeva Platform)
description:
Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**Role Overview:**  
We are seeking a highly motivatedQuality Engineer to support quality assurance activities across enterprise applications with a focus on theVeeva platform. The successful candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into detailed test scenarios and test scripts, executing functional and non-functional testing, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality solutions that meet business and regulatory expectations.
  
The Quality Engineer will work closely with product managers, business analysts, developers, architects, and delivery teams to validate requirements, identify defects, and support end-to-end testing activities. This role will also provide hands-on support for Veeva configuration testing, integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements and convert them into comprehensive test cases and test scripts.
* Design, develop, execute, and maintain manual and automated test assets.
* Perform end-to-end testing across applications, integrations, and business processes.
* Validate functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, usability, security, and reliability considerations.
* Support testing activities related to Veeva platform configurations, workflows, security models, and integrations.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, business stakeholders, and delivery leads to ensure quality objectives are met.
* Identify, document, track, and verify defects through resolution.
* Participate in requirement reviews, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release readiness activities.
* Develop and maintain test plans, test execution reports, and quality metrics.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and business validation efforts.
* Ensure compliance with SDLC, validation, and quality standards in regulated environments.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for testing processes, tools, and methodologies.

**Required Qualifications:**  

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, Testing, or Quality Engineering.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
* Experience creating and executing test cases, test scripts, and test plans.
* Hands-on experience with defect management and test management tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and globally distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience working withVeeva Vault, including configuration and validation testing.
* Understanding of life sciences, pharmaceutical, regulatory, clinical, quality, or RD business processes.
* Experience testing APIs, integrations, and data flows between enterprise systems.
* Knowledge of GxP, CSV (Computer System Validation), and regulated environments.
* Familiarity with test automation frameworks and automated testing tools.
* Experience supporting cloud-based SaaS platforms.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Test Planning and Test Execution
* Functional, Integration, System, Regression, and UAT Testing
* Defect Management and Root Cause Analysis
* Veeva Vault Testing and Configuration Validation
* Requirements Traceability
* API and Integration Testing
* Agile/Scrum Methodologies
* Quality Assurance Best Practices
* Test Documentation and Reporting

title: O+O Engineering lead
description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!
  
  
Who Are We?
  
  
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!
  
  
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH.
  
  
Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC …
  
  
You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment.
  
  
Beyond driving these rollouts, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for building, recruiting, and mentoring a high-performing team (DevOps, Developers, and Engineers) based in Hyderabad to execute this transformation at scale.
  
  
In this role, You will..
  
  
**Be responsible for the following:**  
As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact.
  
  
You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy.
  
  
**In this position your main mission will be:**  

* Engineering mission and leadership:
* Contribute to the engineering vision in line with the Group’s business and technology strategy, and lead its implementation through a distributed, multicultural organization.
* As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs.
* Platform Engineering:
* Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines.
* Support innovation by leveraging generative AI and machine learning capabilities provided by global platforms to accelerate delivery cycles and improve code quality.
* Deploy Group solutions for End-to-end observability & Smart Ops
* Drive the roll-out, adoption, and local improvements of existing global platforms (such as the IDP - Internal Developer Portal ) for tracking and analyzing Value Creation.
* Architecture and industrialization:
* Contribute to architecture choices and engineering standards to ensure performance, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability in modern, distributed cloud environments.
* Be the Gatekeeper for architectural decisions & tracking in partnership with the Global CTO team
* End-to-end delivery:
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from design to production release, accelerating the transformation of ideas, AI use cases, and product innovations into solutions deployed at scale.
* Monitor key engineering metrics, team velocity, and delivery efficiency using standard tooling, providing transparent insights to leadership in both Hyderabad and Paris.
* Transformation through GenAI: Make GenAI a concrete lever for engineering productivity and quality by scaling development copilots, test automation, documentation assistance, assisted refactoring, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices.
* Operational excellence: Strengthen DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure fast, safe, frequent deployments and a high level of availability for critical services.
* Culture and talent: Build a demanding engineering culture based on clarity, ownership, simplicity, and impact, while attracting, developing, and retaining technical talent as part of an insourcing and team scale-up strategy.
* Cross-functional partnership:
* Act as a strategic partner to Product, Architecture, Data, Design, and application domain teams to turn business needs into clear, well-arbitrated technical decisions that create value for brands and markets.
* Ensure seamless collaboration and alignment between local delivery execution in Hyderabad and global architectural standards defined by the O+O CTO team in Paris.

What are we looking for?
  

* Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or delivery management role within a matrix organization.
* Tech Skills
* Proficiency in GCP and Azure environments with ability to design & implement cloud native architectures
* Good knowledge of web development technologies & architectures (React, Vue, Node )
* DevSecOps : ability to design end-to-end CICD pipelines : tests, build, security audit (Checkmarx ), code quality audit (SonarQube ), Infra as Code ( Terraform )
* Vector, Hybrid and Graph RAG and their usual databases (Pinecone, Neo4j, TigerDB, GraphDB, PostgreSQL+pgvector). Re-ranking strategies, retrieval pipelines, Hybrid Symbolic & Neural systems
* Tool calling, agent orchestration ( LangGraph / Langchain / Langsmith, MCP / MCP-UI, DSPy, A2A, A2UI)
* Data Engineering (Delta Architectures, Lambda Architectures, Medaillon pattern, BigQuery, Databricks Lakehouse, Dagster / Airflow / Prefect)
* MLOps (VertexAI, MLFlow)
* Leadership style
* Ability to navigate a matrix organization, influence and collaborate with peers (Marketing, Product, Design, Advanced Engineering)
* Calm, clear, and demanding - in the best sense
* Able to simplify without being simplistic
* Respected by senior engineers and product leaders
* Comfortable making and explaining hard trade-offs
* Mindset
* You believe that simple systems are hard to build, but worth it
* You optimize for long-term leverage, not short-term heroics
* You care deeply about craft, but even more about impact
* Collaborative, structured, results-oriented, and adaptable.
* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent English communication skills; capable of navigating a matrix organization with dual reporting lines between local management (India) and global leadership (Paris).

What’s In It for You?
  
  

* Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future-ready careers.
* A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup.
* Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive.
* Holistic wellbeing offerings - personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best.
* Reward and Recognition opportunities, long-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L’Oréal’s collective success.
* L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

**Good to know:** The Recruitment Process
  
  

* Interview with HR
* Technical Interview
* Interview with the hiring manager

We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

title: Senior Data Engineer - GBS IND
description:
**Job Description:**

**About Us**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

  
  

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

  
  

**Process Overview\***

ADSP owns and manages a set of Authorized Data Sources (ADS) that provide the trusted data behind the bank's regulatory reporting, General Ledger (GL) reconciliation and risk capital models. The ADSP portfolio spans domains: Credit Card, Mortgage, Wealth Management, Consumer Vehicle Lending and Credit Bureau. ADSP maintains accurate data for Finance, Enterprise Risk, Corporate Investments and Global Risk Analytics (GRA) risk models, reconciles Mortgage balances with the bank's GL, and runs ETL from upstream systems, applying enterprise data controls and business rules that meet auditor and regulator expectations.

**Job Description\***

Bank of America is looking for a senior Technology Leader to build, lead and mature the BVH ODS team in GBS India. This role will own end-to-end delivery across engineering, QA, production support and audit/governance, working closely with US leadership and partner teams. The leader will drive the migration of enterprise batch workloads to AutoSys, extend the SOX Data Guardian solution to new domains, lead large-scale modernization programs, and partner with internal and external auditors to ensure controls and compliance. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technology manager with strong people leadership, stakeholder management and execution skills, and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization.

  
  
  

**Responsibilities\***

* Build and mature a multi-functional BVH team in GBS integrating engineering, quality assurance, production support and audit readiness into a single cohesive model.
* Establish knowledge and capability in GBS to reduce key-person dependency and provide coverage across time zones in partnership with the US team.
* Lead the migration of enterprise batch workloads from an in-house scheduling platform to the industry-standard AutoSys scheduling tool, ensuring seamless transition, optimized job orchestration and improved reliability across environments.
* Extend the SOX Data Guardian functionality to the Vehicle domain and ensure the solution is truly domain agnostic and reusable across business domains.
* Drive large-scale modernization and transformation programs, including infrastructure design, application migration, DevOps enablement and platform standardization, while adhering to cost, timeline and quality targets.
* Lead audit and governance activities, partnering with internal and external auditors (EIT, PwC) to validate controls, provide evidence and ensure compliance with regulatory and enterprise standards.
* Own production stability for BVH applications – incident and problem management, root cause analysis, SLA adherence and continuous service improvement.
* Define and enforce engineering, testing and release management best practices, including automation of testing and deployments.
* Manage delivery planning, risks, issues and dependencies; provide clear status and metrics to senior leadership.
* Hire, coach and develop talent; build a strong bench and succession plan for critical roles.
* Partner with US leadership, business, platform, infrastructure and risk teams to align priorities and deliver business outcomes.

  

**Requirements\***

  
  

**Education\***: BE / B.Tech / MCA

  
  

**Certifications if any:** NA

  
  

**Experience Range\***

15 - 20 Years

  
  

**Foundational skills\***

* Proven experience leading and scaling multi-functional technology teams (engineering, QA, production support) in a global delivery model.
* Strong hands-on background in data engineering, ETL and batch processing on enterprise data platforms.
* Experience with enterprise job scheduling tools, preferably AutoSys, including batch migration and job orchestration.
* Solid understanding of SOX controls, IT general controls and audit processes; experience working with internal and external auditors.
* Track record of delivering large modernization programs – application migration, infrastructure design, DevOps/CI-CD and platform standardization.
* Strong production support experience – incident, problem and change management, RCA and SLA governance.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases (Oracle / DB2 / SQL Server).
* Excellent stakeholder management, verbal and written communication skills, including with senior leadership.
  

  

**Desired skills**

* Banking / financial services domain experience; exposure to Vehicle or consumer lending domain is a plus.
* ETL tools (Informatica / DataStage), Unix/Linux shell scripting, Python.
* DevOps tools – Jenkins, Bitbucket/Git, Ansible; cloud and container platforms.
* Test automation and data quality/controls frameworks.
* Agile / SAFe delivery practices.
  

  

**Work Timings\***

10:00 PM to 7:00 PM IST

  
  

**Job Location\***

Hyderabad

title: Senior Architect- AI
description:
**Skill:** Senior Architect- AI

**Exp:** 13 to 18 years

**Location**: Hyderabad

**Shift:** Flexible to work in Shifts

The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi-team Azure programs across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results.

At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements, work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns. You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into repeatable delivery models.

***Responsibilities***

**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that span multiple teams and workstreams.
* Translate client goals into scalable designs that align with business priorities, non-functional requirements, delivery constraints, and program-level outcomes.
* Drive architecture across teams so designs follow shared models, standards, and patterns.
* Collaborate with architects and engineers in other domains to integrate solutions and maintain a cohesive end-to-end architecture.
* Provide ongoing architectural guidance during implementation, including reviews of key designs and code, and define patterns and guardrails that teams can reuse.
* Apply solid engineering practices in your primary domain—modular design, clear interfaces, testability, and observability—so solutions remain robust and maintainable.
* Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help teams adopt effective practices at program scale.

***Delivery and Consulting Excellence***

* Lead or co-lead discovery and roadmap work for programs or large workstreams, turning inputs into integrated, testable backlogs with clear non-functional requirements and dependencies.
* Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time-to-impact.
* Communicate architecture strategy and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives.
* Build trusted relationships with product, engineering, and technology leaders, and help shape modernization roadmaps in the client’s best interest.
* Provide architecture oversight so designs, interfaces, and integration points support predictable delivery and stable team velocity.
* Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies are identified, owned, and tracked through to delivery.
* Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep 3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones.
* Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry and feedback.
* Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple, direct language.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, streamline delivery processes, and drive measurable business value. Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of new digital capabilities is required.
* Proven success operating within large, matrixed consulting organizations and navigating the scale, complexity, governance, and pace of a Global System Integrator (GSI) environment. Ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and consistently deliver results in a fast-paced, performance-driven setting.

***Mentorship and Team Development***

* Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams.
* Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making and showing when to keep solutions simple and when new patterns or technologies are justified.
* Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and mentorship, and by helping shape development plans for future architects.
* Growth and Innovation
* Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities beyond the current assignment across all our capabilities and assisting the sales director in pursuing them.
* Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify opportunities to provide additional business value.
* Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision, contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions.
* Create solution options, high-level designs, and estimates for programs, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and tying them back to business value and risk reduction.
* Build and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter repositories, and templates—that become standard paths for delivery teams.
* Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AI-assisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way.
* Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

***Requirements***

* 10+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary technical domain.
* 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams, including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts.
* Deep expertise across most of the following:
* Agents & Orchestration – leveraging Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar frameworks to design intelligent workflows; applying tool/function calling, planner and agent-based patterns, and workflow automation engines.
* Search & Retrieval – implementing solutions with vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, or Milvus; applying hybrid search methods, re-ranking strategies, and selecting embedding models for accuracy and performance.
* Evaluation, Quality & LLM Operations – establishing offline and online evaluation approaches; using golden datasets, hallucination and groundedness validation, toxicity and safety testing; building telemetry and feedback loops; managing monitoring, deployment pipelines, and ongoing optimization of large language models.
* Responsible AI, Security & Privacy – incorporating practices such as threat modeling, privacy reviews, data minimization, safety guardrails, policy enforcement, auditability, and model risk management in line with GDPR and organizational standards.
* AI Platforms & Data Foundations – applying hands-on experience with Azure AI services, Databricks, Azure OpenAI, and related modern data platforms.
* Cloud Engineering – designing with APIs, containers, microservices, and DevOps pipelines to deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions.
* Data Integration & Governance – developing and managing data pipelines; applying quality controls, metadata practices, and master data management approaches.
* Analytics & Visualization – delivering insights with Power BI and other visualization tools.
* Proficiency with modern development tools (e.g., GitHub, Copilot, Cursor).
* Knowledge of analytics and data science tools, frameworks, and advanced techniques.
* Relevant Azure or Databricks certifications in AI, Data, or Architecture.
* Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based solutions such as modernizations, transformations, or platform build-outs.
* Ability to define solution architectures that connect business goals to scalable technical designs and solid delivery practices.

Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.

You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and content operations — connecting proofs of concept, MVPs, and enterprise-grade platforms to streamline how content is generated, organized, and delivered across every consumer and professional touchpoint.

Deep Agents, Agentic Workflow developments, multi-modal pipelines

title: BY ESP - Lead Engineer
description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

**The Team:**

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Blue Yonder (formerly JDA) ESP Solution Architect/Developer to lead the design, configuration, development and deployment of Enterprise Supply Planning solutions. This role will play a pivotal part in enabling global supply chain transformation by leveraging Blue Yonder’s advanced planning capabilities to optimize supply planning, inventory positioning, and production strategies. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Lead and own the end-to-end architecture and design of Blue Yonder ESP (Enterprise Supply Planning) solutions.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs that align with industry best practices and Blue Yonder's functional framework.
* Define planning models, network design, constraints, and heuristics aligned to business supply strategies.
* Expertise in interpreting solver results ensuring optimized planning quality based on constraints.

**Configuration & Development**

* Configure and develop components within Blue Yonder ESP, including supply planning, inventory balancing, pegging, and constraint-based planning logic.
* Customize ESP engines to align with business supply network models, demand signals, and production capacities.
* Create and manage planning parameters, supply chain hierarchies, and master data elements.

**Implementation & Configuration**

* Configure ESP modules including supply planning, constrained planning, and inventory optimization.
* Guide integration of ESP with up/downstream systems (Demand Planning, ERP, MRP, MES, Google Datalake).
* Oversee data modeling, master data configuration, and rule-based planning logic.

**Technical Leadership & Governance**

* Provide leadership and guidance to implementation teams and technical consultants.
* Review and approve functional and technical design documents.
* Ensure adherence to Blue Yonder standards and change management protocols.

**Business Collaboration & Change Enablement**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders across supply chain, manufacturing, and IT to gather requirements and align solution outcomes.
* Conduct design workshops, walkthroughs, and training sessions to ensure knowledge transfer and user adoption.
* Act as the primary point of contact for solution design decisions and issue resolution.

**Continuous Improvement & Support**

* Identify and propose enhancements for planning performance, configuration, or data integration.
* Support hypercare and transition to steady-state planning operations.
* Evaluate emerging Blue Yonder capabilities and industry trends to evolve the planning landscape**.**
* Contribute to production support and documenting processes and facilitating enablement sessions to empower stakeholders with the necessary skills and knowledge to utilize BY ESP solutions effectively.

  

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* **Experience:** **10+ years** of experience in supply chain planning, with at least 5+ years in Blue Yonder ESP architecture or implementation.
* **Technical Skills:** Hands-on expertise in configuring, designing and deploying Blue Yonder ESP modules (Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, S&OP, Manufacturing Planning) solutions and managing Control-M with extensive experience of MAP solver and ability to understand and interpret solver output ensuring optimal planning results. Strong understanding of planning algorithms (constrained/unconstrained), pegging, and network optimization. Scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) skill is a must. Experience with integration to ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, or Infor. Familiarity with data integration tools (e.g., SAP PI, MuleSoft, Informatica) and batch/scheduled data feeds.
* **Leadership Skills:** Excellent communication, leadership, and client-facing skills.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* **Cultural Awareness:** Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and highly dynamic environment and manage teams across different time zones. Must be multi-tasker and able to prioritize and deliver assignments with the highest quality under pressure with short deadlines.
  

  

* Blue Yonder certification in ESP or SCPO suite is highly desirable.
* Experience in scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) is a significant advantage especially OIL scripts.
* Experience in deploying complex BOM, Load building planning, dynamic deployment functionality is highly preferred.
* Experience in SPARQ solver is a plus.
* Experience in large-scale global supply chain transformation programs.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Knowledge of other Blue Yonder modules (Demand Planning, Sequencing, Control Tower) is a plus.
* Knowledge of Anaplan (planning) models is a plus.
  

  

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
**How We Work:**
  
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* **We execute:** We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
  
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

**Who We Are:**
  
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.

This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Databricks Platform Engineer to support the administration, operation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of our enterprise Databricks platform.
  
The ideal candidate will have experience with Databricks administration, data engineering concepts, platform observability, and technical troubleshooting. This individual will work closely with platform teams, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other technical users to maintain a reliable platform and help diagnose issues related to jobs, pipelines, compute, access, performance, and user environments.
  
  
The role is well suited for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working directly with users, learning new technologies, and experimenting with new Databricks capabilities.
  
  
What will you do in this role
  
  
Databricks Administration Platform Operations
  
  

* Support day-to-day administration and operation of Databricks environments.
* Manage workspaces, compute resources, clusters, SQL Warehouses, jobs/workflows, libraries, and workspace configurations.
* Support user provisioning, permissions, access controls, service principals, and Unity Catalog.
* Monitor platform health, workload performance, utilization, and operational issues.
* Investigate platform and workload failures using logs, job history, compute metrics, and other diagnostic information.
* Help identify whether issues originate from compute, configuration, permissions, data, application code, or other dependencies.
* Assist with platform upgrades, configuration changes, and operational improvements.
* Maintain platform documentation, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.

Data Engineering Workload Support
  
  

* Support data engineering workloads running on Databricks using Spark, PySpark, Python, SQL, Delta Lake, and Databricks Jobs/Workflows.
* Assist teams in troubleshooting failed or poorly performing data pipelines.
* Review job failures, logs, Spark execution behavior, compute utilization, data issues, and dependencies to help identify root causes.
* Work with Data Engineers to troubleshoot ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and processing issues.
* Assist with identifying performance bottlenecks and opportunities to improve workload reliability and efficiency.
* Understand basic Data Lake and Lakehouse architecture concepts and how they relate to Databricks workloads.

Platform Observability Reliability
  
  

* Monitor the health and reliability of Databricks workloads and platform services.
* Help develop and maintain monitoring and dashboards for:
* Job and pipeline failures
* Compute utilization
* Workload performance
* Platform health
* Capacity and usage
* Cost and consumption
* Assist in configuring alerts and identifying recurring failure patterns.
* Participate in troubleshooting incidents and root-cause analysis.
* Help translate recurring incidents into opportunities for automation and platform improvements.
* Work with enterprise monitoring solutions such as CloudWatch, Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or similar technologies.

User Support Troubleshooting
  
  

* Work directly with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, analysts, and other Databricks users to understand and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Support problems involving notebooks, jobs, libraries, compute, permissions, data access, Python/SQL environments, and Spark workloads.
* Guide users through appropriate troubleshooting steps and escalate complex platform issues when needed.
* Document common issues and develop reusable knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Communicate technical issues clearly to both platform teams and end users.
* Provide a positive and collaborative support experience rather than simply routing support tickets.

Data Science AI Enablement
  
  

* Support Databricks environments used by Data Science and analytics teams.
* Understand common Data Science workflows involving Python, SQL, notebooks, Spark, MLflow, and machine learning libraries.
* Assist Data Scientists with environment, library, compute, permissions, and data access issues.
* Support the configuration and operation of compute environments used for Data Science and ML workloads.
* Develop working knowledge of emerging AI/ML capabilities available within the Databricks ecosystem.

Technology Exploration Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Stay informed about new Databricks features, runtimes, administrative capabilities, and platform improvements.
* Experiment with relevant new capabilities in development or test environments.
* Participate in small proofs-of-concept to understand how new features could improve reliability, observability, cost, security, or user experience.
* Share findings with the broader platform team.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive platform administration and support activities.
* Continuously improve technical skills across Databricks, cloud, Data Engineering, and Data Science technologies.

What should you have
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Administration, or Cloud Data Platforms.
* Experience withUnity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks Jobs/Workflows, and SQL Warehouses.
* 1-2 years of hands-on Databricks administration experience.
* Experience working with Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms.
* Understanding of Databricks administration and platform operations.
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL.
* Familiarity with Apache Spark / PySpark and distributed data-processing concepts.
* Understanding of Data Engineering and ETL/ELT concepts.
* Experience troubleshooting technical issues using logs, monitoring information, and application/platform diagnostics.
* Familiarity with cloud environments, preferably AWS.
* Understanding of access management, security, and data governance concepts.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical users and work collaboratively to investigate issues.
* Familiarity withGit, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps practices.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code technologies such asTerraform.
* Exposure to Data Science or AI/ML workloads.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies.

Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
  

* Databricks certification or related training.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such asCloudWatch, Splunk, Datadog, or Grafana.
* Familiarity withMLflow, machine learning workflows, or MLOps concepts.
* Experience supporting enterprise data platforms or scientific computing environments

description:
Sr Director, AI & Engineering (Hyderabad)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring a wide range of talented experts together across a wide range of business-critical services that support our business. Every role within Corporate is vital to furthering our vision of Shortening the Distance from Lab to Life®.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.

**WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE**

Why Syneos Health

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Sets the enterprise engineering and AI-enabled development-lifecycle strategy for a portfolio of products and platforms, translating business priorities into a multi-year capability roadmap, investment thesis, target architecture, and outcome framework.

* Leads Directors, engineering managers, principal engineers, and cross-functional leaders; defines organizational design, decision rights, workforce strategy, succession depth, and leadership expectations across a broad span of control.

* Owns the transformation from AI-assisted development to an AI-native operating model spanning discovery, specification, architecture, coding, review, testing, release, operations, knowledge management, and continuous improvement.

* Establishes enterprise guardrails for AI use in engineering, including approved tools and models, data and intellectual-property protection, human accountability, traceability, evaluation, access controls, model and prompt supply-chain risk, agent permissions, auditability, monitoring, rollback, and retirement.

* Sponsors common developer platforms, reusable AI and agent capabilities, context and knowledge services, reference architectures, paved-road workflows, and automated policy controls that enable teams to scale safely without duplicating solutions.

* Creates portfolio governance for use-case selection and progression from experiment to production, applying value, risk, feasibility, architecture, data readiness, regulatory impact, and total-cost criteria to build, buy, partner, scale, or retire decisions.

* Defines quality and safety standards for AI-generated and AI-enabled software, including specification quality, automated verification, secure development, adversarial and misuse testing, reliability engineering, observability, production evaluation, and incident learning.

* Ensures increased engineering throughput does not compromise stability or maintainability by strengthening internal platforms, loosely coupled architectures, automated testing, version-control discipline, fast feedback loops, and value-stream management.

* Owns a balanced portfolio scorecard covering customer and business value, flow, adoption, quality, security, reliability, cost, developer experience, technical debt, and AI risk; reports outcomes and investment trade-offs to executive stakeholders.

* Builds enterprise capability in product engineering, platform engineering, cloud, data, quality, security, reliability, AI engineering, agent orchestration, specification and context engineering, and critical evaluation of AI outputs.

* Partners with senior Product, Business, Security, Data, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Operations leaders to align AI-enabled delivery with customer needs, regulatory obligations, enterprise risk appetite, and commercial priorities.

* Represents engineering in enterprise planning, investment governance, vendor and strategic-partner decisions, executive risk reviews, and major customer or regulatory engagements.

* Travel required (up to 25%).

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree in technology, business, or a related discipline preferred.

* Typically 15+ years of progressive software engineering and technology leadership experience, including 7+ years leading leaders and accountability for multiple teams, a major portfolio, or an enterprise engineering capability.

* Demonstrated success setting enterprise engineering strategy and delivering multi-year transformation across products, platforms, architecture, talent, operating model, and production operations.

* Proven experience scaling AI-enabled development beyond individual tools or pilots, with measurable outcomes across the lifecycle and operating controls for security, privacy, intellectual property, quality, human oversight, and responsible AI.

* Executive-level understanding of AI-assisted and agentic engineering, including model and tool evaluation, context and knowledge architecture, AI evaluation methods, LLMOps/MLOps, agent permissions and observability, and AI-specific software supply-chain risks.

* Strong record of leading Directors, managers, principal-level talent, global teams, vendors, and strategic partners while building succession depth and durable organizational capability.

* Deep technology breadth across modern architecture, platform engineering, cloud, APIs, distributed systems, data, DevSecOps, quality engineering, observability, reliability, cybersecurity, and regulated production operations.

* Track record of managing significant budgets, investment portfolios, vendor ecosystems, and build-buy-partner decisions using value, risk, cost, and strategic-fit criteria.

* Experience establishing measurable engineering and AI governance using portfolio metrics for value, throughput, stability, quality, security, cost, adoption, talent, and customer outcomes.

* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, clinical, commercial, corporate, or another regulated environment, including privacy, security, audit, validation, and compliance expectations.

Exceptional executive communication, organizational influence, change leadership, financial acumen, and judgment in balancing innovation, delivery speed, risk, resilience, and long-term maintainability.

Are you an experienced Data Engineer who has led the development of world-class software or digital products? Are you looking for an opportunity to expand your scope and lead products used by some of the biggest and most influential businesses around the world? If the answer to these questions is yes, we would like to talk with you.

ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world’s largest professional services firm.

We drive value for our clients by optimizing decisions and actions at a level of granularity only made possible with today’s data and technology. ConvergeCONSUMER’s suite of solutions helps consumer-facing businesses prosper in a world being re-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our team. This role requires both technical fluency in data engineering and an analytical mindset capable of assessing data quality and real-world representativeness. The primary focus of this role is to establish expertise on our library of vendor licensed datasets, perform data pulls to extract insights from the datasets, link and join across datasets, assess the datasets and delivered insights for their validity and believability, and enable downstream data users, including account and product teams, to correctly leverage the data according to their project needs. * Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.

Partners with US-based product and portfolio leaders to translate client needs into scalable data solutions, leveraging and validating complex datasets to generate actionable insights. Collaborates with Product, GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting teams across India and the US.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 10-14 years of relevant consulting experience (or equivalent) with a focus on storytelling and building Model Ready Datasets (MRD) based on analysis of large external and client data sets

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field

* Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.

* Work with Project Managers to understand client requirements and brainstorm on solutions, implement the assets/products as applicable. Perform exploratory data analysis on large datasets (several GB to TB) to define analytical models

* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand analysis requirements and deliver solutions.

* Guide teams to perform exploratory analyses to assess new datasets, identify anomalies, and evaluate representativeness of real-world populations or behaviors across multiple engagements

* Build, test, validate and demonstrate analytical models through various relevant error metrics and calibration techniques. Present the forecasting accuracy results to the client team.

* Partner with external vendors to troubleshoot discrepancies, clarify data definitions, and improve feed quality.

* Ensure compliance with internal governance standards and data-sharing agreements.

* Serve as a subject matter expert on external datasets, helping teams interpret and leverage them effectively for analysis and product development.

* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.

* Use version control tools like GitHub to manage code changes and collaborate with the team

* Support and coach your team on best solutioning practices, development tools, and pathfinding and surveys for technologies

* Set technical direction, coach talent, enforce standards, align product/engineering/ops, and manage engagement risks

* Advanced user of both SQL and Python coding languages with experience in analyzing large data sets

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree in a related field.

* Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset.

* Familiarity with cloud environments and deployment patterns.

* Knowledge of data engineering best practices and methodologies.

* Knowledge of feature engineering and practical experience working with data scientists on enabling production feature engineering pipelines at scale.

* Previous experience in a similar role within a fast-paced development environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Data Quality, EDA, MRD generation & Governance Ownership

* Cross-Functional Collaboration with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and External Vendors

* Vendor & External Dataset Management

* Technical Depth in SQL, Python, and Cloud Data Warehousing (GCP/BigQuery)

* Technical Leadership & Team Coaching

* Clear Communication of Complex Data to Business Stakeholders

**Why This Role Matters**

Product Forward Deployed Engineers bridge deep product and domain expertise with real client problems. They apply data and AI/ML capabilities to deliver scalable solutions, translate client learnings back into the product, and shape how Converge Consumer turns data into better decisions. Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. title: Principal Engineer
description:
***Company Overview***  
*AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through* ***AutoRABIT ARM*** *for CI/CD and release management,* ***CodeScan*** *for static code analysis and application security,* ***Vault*** *for data backup and recovery, and* ***Guard*** *for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance.* ***AutoRABIT official website***  
  
*Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development.* ***AutoRABIT platform overview***  
  
***Job Role***  
*Own the technical direction and delivery outcomes of a major product area or substantial cross-team initiative. This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining deep engineering ability with customer understanding and product judgment. You will shape solutions with Product and Engineering, implement critical components and remain accountable for how they perform after release.*  
  
***Key Responsibilities***

* ***Product and technical direction.*** *Understand customer workflows, adoption barriers and relevant market alternatives with Product and customer-facing teams. Develop evidence-based recommendations on what to improve, simplify or avoid building. Translate agreed priorities into architecture, delivery increments and measurable outcomes.*
* ***Hands-on delivery.*** *Lead design, coding, review, testing and rollout of complex Java services and platform capabilities. Build critical components and reference implementations. Make trade-offs explicit and help teams deliver secure, maintainable software rather than leaving execution at the design stage.*
* ***Production AI judgment.*** *Develop AI-enabled capabilities where they offer meaningful customer value. Define evaluation cases, security boundaries, human approvals where needed, failure handling and acceptable cost and latency. Select conventional engineering approaches when they solve the problem more reliably.*
* ***Reliability and modernisation.*** *Improve performance, scalability, observability, security and tenant isolation within the assigned scope. Address technical debt through staged investments linked to customer or delivery impact. Resolve systemic causes of production problems and improve prevention.*
* ***Cross-team influence.*** *Align interfaces, dependencies and engineering practices across participating teams. Mentor senior engineers and explain decisions clearly. Partner with Product on priorities, Engineering Managers on delivery capacity and the Distinguished Engineer or CTO on company-wide architecture. Document decision ownership and escalate unresolved cross-product trade-offs.*
* *Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.*

***Pride of Ownership***  
*We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.*  
  
***Experience & Desired Skills***  
***Required Skills (Mandatory)***

* *12+ years delivering enterprise software, with demonstrated Principal-level ownership of significant initiatives; scope and outcomes carry more weight than tenure alone.*
* *Deep hands-on Java, Spring Boot, API, microservices and distributed-systems expertise.*
* *Strong enterprise SaaS engineering experience, including security, performance and operational reliability.*
* *Practical AWS or Azure architecture, containers, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD experience.*
* *Experience delivering AI-enabled software or developer productivity capabilities into production and evaluating their effectiveness.*
* *Practical familiarity with relevant AI approaches such as LLMs, RAG, agents or MCP; sound engineering judgment matters more than a particular framework.*
* *Evidence of influencing product decisions, leading cross-team implementation and mentoring senior contributors.*
* *Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders across regions.*

***Preferred Skills (Good to Have)***

* *Salesforce metadata, APIs or release workflows; DevSecOps, CI/CD, data protection or developer-tool products.*
* *Modernisation of complex enterprise platforms and work in regulated or security-sensitive settings.*
* *Significant proprietary product achievements, open-source contributions, publications or patents demonstrating technical influence.*

***What success looks like***

* *Within 90 days, understand the assigned product area, agree outcome measures and identify its most consequential technical constraints.*
* *Within six months, deliver agreed milestones for a substantial initiative and demonstrate improvement against its baseline.*
* *Build durable capability in the team through reusable components, documented decisions and mentoring.*

***Why join AutoRABIT***  
*You will shape important product decisions while remaining close to implementation. This role offers ownership of meaningful customer outcomes and the opportunity to strengthen the technical foundations of AutoRABIT products.*  
  
***Experience:*** *12+ Years*  
***Compensation:*** *75 - 90 Lakhs per annum*  
***Location:*** *Hyderabad*  
***Work Mode:*** *Hybrid - 3 days Work from Office*  
***Work Timings****: IST timings - General Flexible Shift*

title: EH-1521- Data Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** Data Engineer

**Location:** Hyderabad

**Experience**: 8 – 12 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Overlap with US Team (evening IST preferred)

**Staff Data Engineer**

Data Platform & Analytics Engineering · Hyderabad (On-site, Softobiz office)

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Staff Data Engineer to own our end-to-end data platform — from raw event ingestion, through the warehouse, to the analytics marts that the business, product and marketing teams rely on every day. You will be the person who makes sure the numbers we make decisions on are accurate, fresh, reproducible and trusted.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You will partner daily with engineering, analytics, product, growth and external data partners. Success looks like: one canonical patient or customer key across every system, a well-modelled warehouse that answers business questions in SQL rather than spreadsheets, and a data platform that product, marketing and leadership genuinely trust.

*Scope note: this role owns warehouse architecture, pipelines and data modelling. The sister MarTech Engineering role owns event capture at the edge and the delivery of conversion signals to ad platforms. Both roles share one source of truth (the warehouse) and collaborate on the hand-off between event streams and warehouse tables.*

**What You'll Own**

* Warehouse architecture and modelling — BigQuery (or equivalent) as the single source of truth, designed to serve both analytics and activation use cases.
dbt project ownership — model layering (staging intermediate* marts), naming conventions, tests, documentation, exposures, and the promotion workflow from dev to production.
* Ingestion pipelines — event streams from the CDP (Segment or equivalent) landing cleanly in the warehouse, plus structured loads from the product database, billing / payments, ad platforms and third-party SaaS systems.
* Identity resolution in the warehouse — stitching anonymous, edge-level and identified user records into one canonical key, and publishing that key to downstream consumers.
* Core marts — revenue, orders, subscriptions, cohorts, LTV, funnel conversion, channel performance, clinical or operational metrics as the business requires.
* Reverse-ETL / activation models — warehouse tables purpose-built to feed ad-platform conversions APIs, lifecycle marketing, audiences and experimentation tools.
* Data quality and observability — dbt tests, freshness monitors, row-count alerts, reconciliation checks between systems (for example: warehouse orders vs payment processor, warehouse conversions vs ad-platform reports).
* Data governance — PII / PHI handling, column-level masking, row-level security where required, access policies, and the documentation that makes those policies auditable.
* Orchestration and CI/CD — scheduled runs, retries, incremental strategies, pull-request-based dbt reviews, automated tests in CI.
* Partnership with external data partners and the sister MarTech Engineering function — clear ownership lines, shared conventions, joint on-call for pipeline incidents.

**Required Experience**

* 8–12 years in data engineering or analytics engineering at consumer-facing digital businesses — ideally including at least one direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, subscription or marketplace product.
* Deep, hands-on experience designing and maintaining a warehouse on BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift. You can explain partitioning, clustering, materialised views, and cost / performance trade-offs from memory.
* Production experience with dbt — Core or Cloud — including model layering, incremental strategies, snapshots, tests, documentation, exposures, and managing a multi-contributor repo through pull requests.
* Fluent SQL — advanced window functions, CTEs, pivoting, session stitching, slowly-changing-dimension patterns. You can read a 200-line query and tell us what is wrong with it.
* Experience designing identity resolution in the warehouse — merging anonymous, cookie-level, logged-in and server-generated identifiers into one canonical customer key, and publishing that key for downstream systems to join on.
* Hands-on experience building marts for revenue, orders, subscriptions, cohorts, LTV and funnel analysis — and reconciling those marts against authoritative systems (payment processors, billing, ad platforms).
* Python for data work — transformations, orchestration DAGs, small internal tools, and scripting around the warehouse. You do not need to be a backend engineer.
* Working knowledge of at least one workflow orchestrator — Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or equivalent — and the operational discipline that goes with it (idempotency, backfills, retries, alerting).
* Comfort integrating warehouse output into reverse-ETL tooling (Polytomic, Hightouch or Census) so that audiences, conversion events and customer traits can be activated in ad platforms, lifecycle tools and experimentation systems.
* A bias for data contracts and tests over heroics — you treat a broken dashboard as a platform failure to be prevented, not a one-off to be patched.
* Experience operating under ambiguity — a platform migration, re-platforming, or a major tracking overhaul where the "right" schema had to be invented mid-flight.

**Tools and Technologies**

The following stack describes what you will work with day-to-day. You do not need hands-on experience with every single tool — depth in 60–70% of this list is what we are looking for, along with the pattern-matching to pick up the rest quickly.

**Category**

**Tools**

  

Data Warehouse

BigQuery (required), Snowflake or Redshift. Strong grasp of partitioning, clustering, cost controls.

  

Transformation

dbt Core or dbt Cloud (required), dbt tests, snapshots, exposures, packages.

  

Orchestration

Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or an equivalent DAG runner. dbt Cloud scheduling for dbt-only pipelines.

  

Ingestion

Segment (CDP warehouse), Fivetran or Airbyte (SaaS warehouse), custom Python ingestion where needed.

  

Reverse-ETL / Activation

Polytomic (preferred), Hightouch, Census — mapping marts to ad-platform, lifecycle and experimentation destinations.

  

Product Analytics (consumer)

Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Heap — you will not own these tools, but you will land their events and feed their user properties from the warehouse.

  

BI / Visualisation

Omni, Looker, Mode, Metabase, Tableau — warehouse-native semantic modelling preferred.

  

Languages

SQL (advanced), Python (fluent), Jinja (dbt); shell scripting as needed.

  

Storage & Cloud

Google Cloud Platform primary (Cloud Storage, IAM, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run / Cloud Functions).

  

Governance & PII

Column-level security, masking policies, row-level access, data-classification tagging, audit logging.

  

Dev workflow

Git, GitHub / GitLab, pull-request reviews, dbt CI, unit and schema tests, dbt docs.

  

Collaboration

Linear, Slack, Google Docs & Sheets, Confluence or Notion.

**Nice to Have**

* Healthcare, fintech, or other privacy-sensitive domain experience — designing a warehouse that respects PII / PHI boundaries and survives audit.
* Experience operating a dbt repo shared between an internal team and an external data partner (or vendor) — conventions, code review, ownership boundaries.
* Experience with Segment Unify, identity-graph services, or custom identity-resolution frameworks.
* Hands-on with experimentation data — building the exposures, assignment and outcome tables that power A/B test readouts and feeding them to an experimentation platform.
* Hands-on with LTV or propensity modelling (regression, survival or tree-based), and with getting those predictions into the warehouse as first-class tables.
* Familiarity with streaming patterns — Pub/Sub, Kafka, Kinesis — and when to prefer them over batch.
* Prior early-hire data platform experience at a growth-stage product company, where you set the conventions rather than inherited them.

**How You Work**

* You treat the warehouse as a product — versioned, documented, tested, with clear ownership of every model and every downstream exposure.
* You are as comfortable debugging a BigQuery cost regression as you are explaining an attribution or LTV model to senior leadership.
* You write dbt tests before you write dashboards. You would rather catch the problem in CI than in a Monday standup.
* You draw scope lines honestly — you know where your layer ends and the MarTech, product or ML layer begins, and you document the hand-off.
* You reconcile aggressively — warehouse vs payment processor, warehouse vs ad platforms, warehouse vs the product UI. Anything that does not tie out is a ticket, not a footnote.
* You write things down. The team should not need to re-learn a modelling decision you have already made.

**Compensation and Logistics**

* Location: On-site at our Hyderabad (Softobiz) office. This is not a remote role.
* Reporting: Reports to the Engineering Owner, with regular working interactions across product, analytics, growth and external data partners.
* Compensation: Competitive base salary plus performance bonus and standard benefits.
* Schedule: Full-time, with some overlap expected with partner teams in other time zones.

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a short note (5–10 sentences) describing the most complex data platform or warehouse migration you have personally led — what you inherited, what you shipped, and what you would do differently. Links to open-source contributions, dbt packages, public writing or talks are welcome.

**About Softobiz:**

Innovation begins with like-minded people aiming to transform the world together. At Softobiz, we invite you to become a part of an organization that has been helping clients transform their business by fusing insights, creativity, and technology. With a team of 300+ technology enthusiasts, we have been trusted by leading enterprises around the globe for over 12+ years.

At Softobiz, we foster a culture of equality, learning, collaboration, and creative freedom, empowering our employees to grow and excel in their careers. Our technical craftsmen are pioneers in the latest technologies like AI, machine learning, and product development.

**Why Should You Join Softobiz?**

* Access training sessions and skill-enhancement courses for personal and professional growth.

Softobiz is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
