title: Tech Architect
description:
**Position Details**

* Department: Engineering / Technology
* Reports to: VP of Engineering / CTO
* Location: Hyderabad, India
* Work arrangement: In-office only
* Employment type: Full-time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Tech Architect to define and drive the technical direction of our SaaS platform. You will architect and build scalable backend web services; design analytics pipelines for drone-captured images and videos; enable enterprise-grade single sign-on (SSO) and a secure, extensible integration layer; and turn proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. You will also champion AI/LLM-powered agentic coding to improve engineering productivity, while setting high standards for security, quality, scalability, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define end-to-end architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, balancing scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost.
* Assess existing POC and prototype code, determine what can be reused versus re-architected, and define a practical path to production and go-live.
* Production-harden prototypes through robust error handling, logging, monitoring, automated testing, security controls, configuration management, and performance tuning.
* Own production-readiness reviews, load and performance testing, CI/CD and deployment strategies (including blue-green and canary releases), rollback plans, and post-launch support.
* Architect scalable analytics pipelines for drone-captured imagery and video, covering live-stream and bulk-field-upload ingestion, processing, model inference, storage, and API-based delivery of results.
* Address drone-data constraints, including large high-resolution media, intermittent or low-bandwidth connectivity, GPS and flight telemetry, altitude, gimbal/camera orientation, timestamps, and mapping data to missions, sites, and assets.
* Make architecture decisions for real-time versus batch processing, GPU/accelerator utilization, edge versus cloud inference, and cost optimization for media-heavy workloads.
* Architect enterprise identity and SSO using SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0; support per-tenant SSO configuration, integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and session management.
* Design and own the platform’s extensibility and integration layer, including public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension models for customer, partner, third-party, drone-platform, and fleet-management integrations, with versioning, backward compatibility, and safe sandboxing.
* Own end-to-end security architecture, including API gateway and WAF controls, authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets and key management, audit logging, and tenant data isolation.
* Drive secure-by-design practices through threat modelling, security reviews of designs and code, dependency and vulnerability management, and penetration-test remediation—including for AI-generated code and third-party extensions/integrations.
* Architect and oversee backend services, including REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and service-to-service communication.
* Remain hands-on: write and review production-grade backend code, build POCs, and demonstrate engineering standards by example.
* Design core SaaS capabilities such as multi-tenancy, subscription and billing integration, tenant data isolation, rate limiting, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead adoption of AI/LLM agentic coding tools such as Claude Code for delivery acceleration, refactoring, and productionizing prototype code.
* Establish workflows and best practices for AI-assisted software development, including code-review standards, guardrails, and quality gates for AI-generated code.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Define technical standards, coding guidelines, and architectural patterns across engineering teams; evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, tools, and emerging AI/LLM and computer-vision capabilities.
* Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs), guide low-level designs (LLDs), identify technical debt, and lead legacy-system modernization, using AI-assisted tools where beneficial.
* Ensure architecture meets non-functional requirements for scalability, availability, security, tenant isolation, and observability.
* Mentor senior engineers and tech leads on architecture, productionizing prototypes, and effective use of AI coding assistants.
* Lead POCs for new technologies, LLM/agentic workflows, vision models, and major system changes.
* Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on infrastructure, deployment, and CI/CD architecture.
* Own architecture documentation and keep it current across the organization.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in architecture-focused roles.
* Proven experience building and scaling SaaS products end to end, ideally from early-stage development through growth.
* A demonstrated track record of taking POCs/prototypes to production through refactoring, re-architecture, hardening, and successful live launches with measurable reliability and performance.
* Strong backend engineering experience designing, building, and scaling production REST/GraphQL APIs and microservices.
* Experience designing or building systems that ingest and process drone-generated aerial imagery and video at scale, including use cases such as object detection, change detection, classification, tracking, and inspection.
* Understanding of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTMP, WebRTC, HLS), encoding/transcoding, and large-scale media storage.
* Experience with drone data and metadata, including geo-tagged imagery, flight telemetry, geospatial context, and data flows from device or ground station to cloud.
* Familiarity with production deployment and serving of computer-vision/ML models, including inference optimization, GPU workloads, batching, and model versioning; exposure to OpenCV, FFmpeg, or similar frameworks.
* Hands-on experience implementing enterprise SSO and authentication using SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, and SCIM in multi-tenant SaaS products, including integration with major identity providers.
* Experience designing extensible platforms with public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension or third-party integration frameworks, including versioning, rate limiting, and safe extension isolation.
* Strong security architecture skills covering API security, encryption, secrets management, tenant isolation, secure SDLC, threat modelling, and OWASP Top 10 risks and mitigations.
* Mandatory hands-on coding capability; this is an active engineering role, not solely an architecture-review position.
* Practical, demonstrable use of AI/LLM-based agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) in real engineering workflows, beyond casual use.
* Strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing systems, and SaaS scalability patterns.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including managed GPU/ML and media services.
* Deep proficiency in at least one major backend language/stack: Java, Python, Node.js, .NET, or Go.
* Deep understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, caching strategies (Redis or Memcached), and object storage.
* Strong experience with API design, API gateways, messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and service-integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and production observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
* Understanding of LLM fundamentals—prompting, context management, tool/function calling, RAG, agentic workflows, and multimodal models—sufficient to architect responsible AI integrations.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Working knowledge of compliance and data-control frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, including privacy and data-retention considerations for aerial imagery and video. Regulated-industry experience is a plus, not mandatory.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading architecture reviews and building consensus across engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with drone SDKs/platforms such as DJI, MAVLink, PX4, or ArduPilot, or with drone fleet and mission-management software.
* Experience with geospatial and photogrammetry tooling, including GIS, orthomosaics, 3D reconstruction, GDAL, or PostGIS.
* Experience with edge/on-device inference or low-latency real-time video processing at a ground station or on a drone.
* Experience with video analytics platforms or stream-processing frameworks such as GStreamer, NVIDIA DeepStream, or Triton Inference Server.
* Experience building a developer ecosystem or marketplace, including partner APIs, app/extension marketplaces, and developer portals.
* Experience with zero-trust architecture, mutual TLS (mTLS), WAF/API-gateway policy design, or security tooling such as SAST/DAST and SIEM integrations.
* Experience with API monetization, usage-based billing, or SaaS metering systems.
* Experience building or integrating LLM-powered applications or agents in production.
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent-tooling frameworks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization and orchestration technologies.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Experience with SRE practices, including SLOs/SLAs, incident response, and capacity planning.
* Prior experience scaling SaaS systems from startup to enterprise scale.
* Relevant certifications, such as AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF, or security certifications.

**Role Expectations**

* Be a hands-on technical leader who can move fluidly between architecture, implementation, code review, production readiness, and technical mentoring.
* Balance rapid delivery with long-term maintainability, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Build consensus across teams and communicate trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Application note: Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate hands-on backend engineering, productionizing POCs, SaaS architecture, drone-media/data pipeline design, enterprise SSO and security architecture, and practical use of AI-assisted coding tools.

Summary:
  
As a Senior AWS Integration Architect, you will design and implement enterprise-scale AWS integration platforms, cloud-native architectures, and metadata-driven integration frameworks. The role requires extensive expertise in AWS Glue-based data integration solutions, serverless architectures, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and modern cloud integration patterns.  
The architect will leverage AWS services such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, CloudFormation, CDK (TypeScript), and CodeBuild to build scalable, secure, and high-performance integration solutions. Strong experience in Python, PySpark, SQL, and TypeScript is required, along with expertise in Data Mesh architectures, multi-tenant integration platforms, cross-account deployments, and event-driven integration patterns.  
The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to deliver cloud solutions using Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and modern AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and accelerate software delivery.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
1. Design and architect enterprise-scale AWS Glue-based data integration solutions for cloud-native applications and Data Mesh platforms.

3. Develop and optimize AWS Glue ETL jobs using Python and PySpark for large-scale data processing and transformation.
  
4. Design metadata-driven and configuration-over-code integration frameworks using JSON schemas and reusable architecture patterns.
  
5. Build scalable, event-driven integration pipelines supporting JDBC, REST APIs, SFTP, and messaging-based integrations.
  
6. Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using AWS CDK (TypeScript) and CloudFormation.
  
7. Lead multi-tenant architecture decisions and cross-account deployment strategies across AWS environments.

9. Implement CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodeBuild, Jenkins, GitHub, and DevOps best practices.
  
10. Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams to gather requirements, conduct architecture reviews, and deliver solution demonstrations.
  
11. Ensure security, governance, monitoring, and operational excellence across AWS integration platforms.
  
12. Optimize AWS solutions for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  
13. Mentor development teams and establish best practices for cloud-native integration and automation.
  
14. Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to improve engineering productivity and accelerate SDLC processes.
  
15. Work closely with Agile teams to deliver high-quality cloud solutions following DevOps and continuous integration practices.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
1. 10 12+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing AWS cloud integration solutions.
  
2. Strong expertise in AWS Glue for ETL development, data transformation, workflow orchestration, and enterprise data integration.
  
3. Extensive experience with AWS services including AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Athena, Amazon SQS, and AWS CodeBuild.
  
4. Experience with AWS CDK (TypeScript) and AWS CloudFormation for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated cloud provisioning.
  
5. Good understanding of AWS security services including Amazon Cognito, AWS WAF, AWS Certificate Manager, Amazon CloudFront, Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon SageMaker.
  
6. Strong programming skills in Python, PySpark, SQL, and TypeScript.
  
7. Experience developing serverless applications and backend services using AWS Lambda and TypeScript.
  
8. Expertise in developing, optimizing, and troubleshooting AWS Glue ETL jobs using Python and PySpark.
  
9. Strong knowledge of Data Mesh architecture, metadata-driven integration, and configuration-over-code platform design.
  
10. Experience designing event-driven architectures using EventBridge, Step Functions, Lambda, and SQS.
  
11. Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns including REST APIs, JDBC, SFTP, and asynchronous messaging.
  
12. Experience designing multi-tenant integration platforms and cross-account AWS deployment strategies.
  
13. Proficiency in JSON schema design, metadata management, and reusable integration frameworks.
  
14. Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodeBuild, Jenkins, GitHub, and DevOps practices.

17. Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies.

Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced QA Lead Engineer to drive quality engineering initiatives across enterprise applications and digital platforms. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in test automation, API testing, database validation, quality assurance processes, and technical leadership. In this role, you will lead quality strategy, establish automation frameworks, mentor QA teams, and collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, and DevOps teams to ensure delivery of secure, reliable, scalable, and high-quality software solutions.

  

* **Role: QA Lead Engineer**

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Lead QA strategy, test planning, estimation, execution, and reporting across enterprise applications.

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for Web Testing, API Testing, Database Testing, Integration Testing.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

* Experience managing testing deliverables, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, and DevOps practices.

* Strong programming skills using Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python.
* Experience designing reusable and scalable automation frameworks.
* Ability to improve automation coverage and testing efficiency.
* Extensive experience in API Testing, API Automation, Service Testing, Integration Testing.
* Hands-on experience with Postman, REST Assured, Swagger, API Validation Tools.
* Experience testing RESTful and microservices-based architectures.
* Strong understanding of request/response validation and API security testing.
* Strong SQL and database testing expertise.
* Experience with Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Data Integrity Testing, Backend Testing.
* Ability to write complex SQL queries for validation and reporting.
* Experience testing transactional and distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of Performance Testing, Load Testing, Stress Testing, Security Testing.
* Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
* Understanding of application security and vulnerability testing concepts.
* Experience validating non-functional requirements.
* Hands-on experience with Git, Jenkins, Maven, Gradle, Azure DevOps.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of DevOps and shift-left testing practices.
* Experience supporting automated deployment validation.
* Familiarity with cloud-based testing environments.
* Knowledge of Service Virtualization, Test Data Management, Containerized Environments, Microservices Testing.
* Understanding of distributed architectures and cloud-native applications.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum delivery environments.
* Strong ability to collaborate with business, product, and engineering stakeholders.
* Experience managing cross-functional testing activities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and reporting skills.
* Ability to drive quality-focused decision making across teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and decision-making skills.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

**Role Overview:** **As an** ***Applied AI Platform Engineer II*****, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.**
* **Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.**
* **Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.**
* **Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.**
* **Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.**
* **Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.**
* **Possess expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.**
* **Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.**
* **Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.**

**The team:** **US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.**

**The successful candidate will possess:**

**§** **Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.**

**Required Qualifications:**

**§** **A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.**

**§** **5+ years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.**

**§** **3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).**

title: Assoc. Dir. DDIT ISC CSOC Engineering - Cloud
description:
### **Summary**

We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Detection Engineer to help shape the future of cloud security monitoring at Novartis. You will design, build, validate and continuously improve detection capabilities across Azure, AWS and other strategic cloud platforms while being a key partner with incident response and cloud security architect teams. An engineering role that combines cloud telemetry, custom detections, threat research, automation and AI-assisted investigation to create high-signal, scalable outcomes for Cyber Defense.
  
  
Role purpose:
  
  
Build a robust, AI-native cloud detection pipeline that improves correlation and investigation efficiency across multi-cloud environments. Engineer fragmented cloud telemetry into clear, actionable security outcomes with AI embedded throughout the detection engineering lifecycle. A multidimensional engineering role at the intersection of automation, cloud architecture, threat behavior analysis, detection engineering supporting analyst investigation workflows.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and operate an AI-native cloud detection pipeline that aggregates, correlates, enriches, deduplicates and prioritizes signals before analyst investigation
* Build and tune high-fidelity detections that improve coverage across cloud control-plane, data plane and management-plane activity, identity and access, network, container and Kubernetes and security posture.
* Use lower-fidelity and behavioral signals as investigation context, while ensuring known high-confidence detections are consistently escalated for security investigation
* Integrate and correlate telemetry from WIZ, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, AWS GuardDuty, Microsoft Sentinel and other cloud-native or CNAPP sources . Apply hands-on Wiz experience to interpret posture findings, attack paths, identity and exposure context, cloud events, runtime findings and threat detections and improve detection workflows
* Develop behavioral baselines and entity-centric analytics across users, IP addresses, identities and cloud resources . Create reusable dashboards, dynamic lookups and enrichment patterns enabling rapid pivots / drilldowns from an alert to related resource, identity, inventory and historical data
* Own the detection lifecycle from threat hypothesis and telemetry assessment through development, peer review, testing, deployment, tuning, documentation and retirement
* Embed AI across the detection lifecycle to accelerate detection creation and tuning, while ensuring engineering controls and human judgment govern the outcomes
* Finetune detections using historical data, controlled simulations, purple-team exercises, attack emulation and lessons learned from incidents and threat hunts
* Use detection-as-code practices, Git, CI/CD and automated testing to deliver controlled, repeatable and auditable content changes . Partner with Threat Hunting and Response, CSOC analysts, cloud platform teams, data onboarding, threat intelligence and automation teams to close visibility gaps and operationalize detections
Automate enrichment and triage using Python, APIs, SOAR workflows and AI-assisted approaches, with appropriate human oversight for security decisions . Measure and improve detection coverage, precision, false-positive rate, investigation volume, alert latency, data quality and analyst effort  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security, detection engineering, security analytics, threat hunting, incident response or security platform engineering
* Working knowledge of Azure and AWS security architectures, respective cloud domains and workloads
* Understanding of cloud telemetry and logging sources such as Azure Activity and Diagnostic logs, Entra ID logs, AWS CloudTrail, AWS CloudWatch and GuardDuty findings
* Experience in working with CNAPP bundles or developing and tuning detections in Wiz, Vega or cloud-native security platforms
* Proficiency in KQL and at least one scripting or programming language such as Python. CloudShell understanding is expected
* Familiarity with AI/LLM-assisted security investigation, agentic workflows or machine-learning approaches to signal enrichment and triage . Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, threat-informed defense, entity mapping, correlation, enrichment and alert prioritization
* Ability to investigate complex datasets, distinguish true security risk from operational noise and communicate engineering decisions clearly . Experience collaborating across security operations, cloud engineering and platform teams in a global environment.
Experience with detection-as-code, Sigma or YAML-based content, Git, CI/CD, unit/integration testing and safe deployment or rollback practices . Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation or equivalent. Background in threat intelligence, purple teaming, red teaming, incident response or cloud threat research  

**Desirable Requirement:**

  
  

* Relevant certifications such as AZ-500, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, GIAC Cloud Security certifications, CCSP or equivalent practical expertise.
* GIAC Cloud Forensics Responder (GCFR)

title: SOX ITGC Controls & SOX Key Reports
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-256190 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 15, 2026 CATEGORY: Engineering

**Job Description**
===================

The Specialist role is a key member of the Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team within Cybersecurity and Digital Trust (CDT). The position is responsible for supporting Amgen's Information Technology Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Compliance program, with primary responsibilities across SOX IT General Controls (ITGCs) and SOX Key Reports.

The Specialist will partner with IT SOX Compliance leadership, system and service owners, engineers, developers, Finance, Compliance, Corporate Audit, and Internal and External Audit teams to support the design, execution, monitoring, validation, and continuous improvement of SOX IT controls and key reports.

The role requires a strong understanding of IT controls combined with the technical ability to analyze systems, applications, report logic, data flows, queries, and supporting technologies to ensure SOX controls and reports are appropriately designed, documented, operated, and supported.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**SOX ITGC Controls**
---------------------

* Support the execution and ongoing management of the ITGC SOX Controls and Compliance program.

* Coordinate and support quarterly and annual SOX certification activities with control owners, process owners, system owners, and other stakeholders.

* Review control documentation and supporting evidence to assess control execution, identify potential gaps, and ensure SOX requirements are appropriately addressed.

* Partner with control owners to strengthen control design, documentation, evidence quality, and operational effectiveness.

* Participate in SOX walkthroughs with system, service, process, and control owners.

* Support Internal and External Audit evidence requests, testing inquiries, walkthroughs, and remediation activities.

* Review SOX systems and applications within the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) to assess SOX applicability and ensure relevant system components and dependencies are appropriately identified.

* Assess IT audit findings, identify relevant mitigating controls, support root cause analysis, and coordinate remediation activities through completion.

* Support the design, implementation, and effectiveness of SAP GRC SOX ITGC controls, including Logical Access, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and Emergency Access.

* Support SAP GRC processes such as Access Request, Risk Analysis, Role Management, user access lifecycle activities, and Emergency Access.

* Support key access controls including role reviews, privileged access monitoring, access governance, and related issue remediation.

* Partner with IT Security, SAP Basis, application teams, and other technology stakeholders to ensure appropriate implementation and operation of controls across SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and integrated systems.

* Develop and maintain SOX guidance, procedures, training materials, and educational resources to support control and process owners.

* Promote compliance by design by partnering with IT teams to embed appropriate controls within technology processes and solutions.

**SOX Key Reports Analysis & Validation**
-----------------------------------------

* Serve as a key contributor to the SOX Key Reports program for system-generated reports relied upon in the execution of SOX controls.

* Perform technical analysis of report logic, including application code, queries, scripts, calculations, configurations, data transformations, and report parameters.

* Validate the completeness and accuracy of SOX Key Reports by reconciling report outputs to source systems and underlying data.

* Review custom-developed and configurable report logic, including technologies such as SAP ABAP, SQL, ERP reporting tools, and other financial applications.

* Analyze and interpret technical artifacts including SQL queries, stored procedures, ETL logic, interfaces, application code, and data transformations.

* Recreate or independently generate report outputs, where applicable, using reviewed queries, application logic, or ERP report code to validate report accuracy.

* Perform report tie-outs between reports provided by Process Owners and independently generated outputs.

* Reconcile record counts, key data fields, financial totals, parameters, and reporting periods between source data and report outputs.

* Confirm report parameters, filters, date ranges, calculations, and report logic align with the intended SOX control objective.

* Verify whether manual manipulation or post-extraction adjustments have been applied to system-generated reports and assess their impact.

* Investigate and document variances identified during report validation and ensure explanations and resolutions are appropriately supported.

* Identify potential gaps, defects, or risks associated with report logic, data integrity, interfaces, system changes, or report generation.

* Support remediation and re-testing when key report logic, documentation, or report outputs do not meet SOX requirements.

* Partner with system owners, developers, Process Owners, Finance, Compliance, and Audit teams to understand report design, data flows, system dependencies, and control requirements.

* Ensure SOX Key Reports meet applicable documentation and testing expectations, including completeness, accuracy, access, and change management considerations.

  
  

**Audit, Risk & Compliance Support**
------------------------------------

* Serve as a knowledgeable point of contact for Internal and External Audit inquiries related to ITGC controls and SOX Key Reports.

* Prepare and provide clear, complete, and timely audit evidence, technical explanations, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.

* Participate in walkthroughs, audit testing, remediation discussions, and re-testing activities.

* Work with stakeholders to identify control or report deficiencies, evaluate associated risks, and drive issues through remediation.

* Ensure quality, completeness, and timeliness across assigned SOX and compliance deliverables.

* Maintain awareness of changing technology environments, implementation methodologies, regulatory expectations, and emerging technologies that may impact IT controls and compliance.

* Identify opportunities to improve and automate SOX compliance, control monitoring, evidence collection, report validation, and related processes.

  
  

**Technical Skills & Experience**
=================================

* Strong understanding of SOX IT General Controls, IT controls, control design, control testing, and audit principles.

* Experience supporting SOX compliance, IT audit, IT risk, Information Security controls, or technology control assurance.

* Experience working with ERP platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, Oracle, Workday, and/or PeopleSoft.

* Ability to review and understand queries, scripts, application logic, and report code; experience with SQL, SAP ABAP, Python, or similar technologies is preferred.

* Understanding of data flows, system interfaces, ETL processes, access controls, and change management.

* Experience with data analysis and reconciliation tools such as Alteryx, Python, Oracle SQL Developer, or similar technologies is preferred.

* Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, ITIL, SDLC, Agile, and/or DevOps methodologies.

* Experience with Governance, Risk and Compliance tools such as AuditBoard, SAP GRC, ServiceNow IRM, or similar platforms.

* Experience with financial systems or applications such as Anaplan and Model N is an advantage.

* Knowledge of Information Security and Information Governance principles and relevant industry frameworks and standards.

* Experience supporting Internal and External Audit teams, including experience communicating with external auditors.

* Financial controls, financial reporting, or Big Four IT Audit/SOX advisory experience is an advantage.

  
  

**Key Competencies**
====================

* Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills.

* Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, quality, and complete documentation.

* Ability to translate complex technical concepts, system logic, and data flows into clear business and control language.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical and compliance matters to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines.

* Demonstrated ownership and accountability with the ability to independently drive activities through completion.

* Ability to work effectively across IT, Information Security, Finance, Compliance, Audit, and business teams in a global environment.

* Strong collaboration and stakeholder-management skills.

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and navigate complexity and ambiguity.

* Technical curiosity and willingness to understand new technologies, systems, processes, and emerging compliance risks.

* Team-oriented approach with a focus on achieving overall program and organizational objectives.

  
  

**Basic Qualifications**
========================

Master's degree

**OR**

Bachelor's degree and 2 years of Information Systems experience

**OR**

Associate's degree and 6 years of Information Systems experience

**OR**

High school diploma/GED and 8 years of Information Systems experience.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* 8+ years of experience in IT Audit, SOX compliance, Information Technology/Security control assurance, enterprise IT compliance, or a related field.

* Experience supporting SOX ITGC controls and/or SOX Key Report validation.

* Experience working in large, global corporate environments involving multiple business and technology functions.

* Experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another regulated industry is preferred.

* Experience with SAP environments, including SAP S/4HANA, ECC, and SAP GRC.

* Experience reviewing report logic, source data, queries, scripts, and system-generated reports.

* Knowledge of Information Security standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001/27002, NIST, or comparable frameworks.

* Experience working within Agile and/or DevOps environments.

* Strong presentation and stakeholder communication skills.

  
  

**Industry-recognized certifications are preferred, including:**

* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)

* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

* SANS Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC)

Job Title: Cloud Data Engineer – Databricks, dbt Cloud & AWS

**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Key Experience:** 5+ years in Databricks and 3+ years in cloud-based data lake/lakehouse architecture  
**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Data Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, dbt Cloud, and AWS to help build, maintain, and optimize scalable enterprise data platforms.

The ideal candidate will have experience in data engineering, data warehousing, cloud data lake architecture, and enterprise-scale ETL/ELT pipelines. This role involves modernizing legacy data warehouse implementations, converting SQL and PL/SQL business logic into scalable Spark SQL transformations, and developing modular data products using dbt Cloud and dbt Mesh.

The candidate will also contribute to platform reliability, performance tuning, cost optimization, data governance, and automated deployment workflows.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze existing data warehouse implementations and support migration and consolidation initiatives.
* Reverse-engineer legacy SQL and PL/SQL stored procedures and convert business logic into scalable Spark SQL transformations within Databricks.
* Design and develop AWS-based data lake and lakehouse solutions using S3, Databricks, and Delta Lake.
* Build, maintain, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion frameworks.
* Develop reusable transformation pipelines using dbt Cloud, including models, tests, macros, incremental models, snapshots, seeds, and documentation.
* Design and manage multi-project dbt Mesh architectures, including cross-project references, model contracts, model versioning, and access controls.
* Configure and maintain dbt Cloud environments, jobs, deployment schedules, and CI checks across development, QA, and production.
* Optimize data models, including Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, flattened models, and modern lakehouse approaches.
* Tune Spark and Databricks workloads through partitioning, query optimization, performance improvements, and cost management.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to data lakes, pipelines, scheduled jobs, and data processing.
* Perform foundational data administration activities, including job scheduling, error troubleshooting, and backup coordination.
* Collaborate with data architects and cross-functional teams to align ingestion and transformation frameworks with enterprise standards.
* Maintain GitHub repositories, manage branching and merging strategies, review pull requests, resolve merge conflicts, and support release management.
* Build and maintain CI/CD workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment of dbt and Databricks code.
* Document ETL processes, data flows, transformation logic, and technical solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog grooming, and iterative delivery.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 5–8 years of overall experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or big data platform development.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks, including Spark SQL, PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows/Jobs, and performance optimization.
* Strong practical experience with dbt Cloud, including models, tests, Jinja macros, incremental models, snapshots, jobs, environments, and deployments.
* Experience with dbt Mesh, including multi-project architecture, cross-project references using ref(), model contracts, versioning, and governance/access controls.
* Strong knowledge of AWS data services, including S3, Glue, Lambda, IAM, Step Functions, and CloudWatch; exposure to Redshift or EMR is beneficial.
* At least 3 years of experience designing and implementing cloud-based data lake or lakehouse architectures using Databricks.
* Strong understanding of Spark technologies, including Spark SQL, PySpark, or Scala.
* Advanced SQL and PL/SQL skills, including the ability to analyze, understand, and refactor legacy stored procedures.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and enterprise-scale ETL/ELT pipeline development.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language: Python, Scala, or Java.
* Experience with performance tuning, partitioning strategies, scalability, and cloud cost optimization.
* Strong GitHub skills, including branching, merging, pull requests, code reviews, and repository management.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps practices for data engineering workflows, preferably using GitHub Actions.
* Experience working in Agile project environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

* Databricks Associate or Professional certification.
* dbt Analytics Engineering certification.
* Experience with enterprise data governance, metadata management, and data catalog platforms such as Unity Catalog.
* Exposure to AWS Redshift and EMR.

What We Are Looking For

A hands-on Cloud Data Engineer who can modernize legacy data platforms, develop reliable data products, implement scalable dbt and Databricks solutions, and collaborate effectively with architects and cross-functional teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at **hr@spasnik.com** or reach out via direct message.

description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**

  

**R&D Data Management Expert - Data and AI**

**Job Posting Title**

R&D Data Management Expert - Data and AI

**Job Description Summary**

Develops, implements, and administers policies and procedures to ensure the quality and protection of organizational data, aligning with strategic priorities and regulatory requirements to minimize risk. Collaborates with leadership to define specific roles and responsibilities related to the organizations data assets, ensuring clarity in data stewardship. Develops and maintains rules and policies governing data management and access restrictions, promoting best practices in data governance. By fostering a culture of compliance and accountability, plays a critical role in safeguarding the organizations data integrity and security.

**PURPOSE**

Insight generation and business process optimization across R&D by ensuring internally generated data as well as externally sourced data are **FAIR+Q** (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable, and of Quality). This is achieved, among other things, through the development and implementation of key data capabilities:

* **Data and AI Catalog:** Central location to find data assets, data models, AI Models, applications and related governance information
* **Business Information Modeling:** Connecting and describing data across domains
* **Reference Data Capability:** Providing standards for use in information models and workflows.
* **Business Data Architecture:** Charting data flow across business processes and systems
* **Master Data Capability:** Maintaining authoritative sources of key business data concepts such as project, product, sites etc. to gain a trusted, current view of these key data

The role will be responsible for the vision and delivery of the Data and AI Cataloging Capability while closely collaborating with Business Information Modeling, Business Data Architecture, Reference Data Standards, and other relevant data and AI capabilities. The domain scope of the role is all of R&D. The Data and AI Catalog expert acts as a business leader in initiatives involving the cataloguing of data, data models, AI models, governance policies and related information to allow humans and AI Agents access to information that is relevant for business workflows. The role collaborates closely with stakeholders across the organization to strengthen discoverability, understanding, ownership, quality, and usage conditions of R&D data assets.

  

**STAKEHOLDERS**

The role will interact and establish strong partnerships with

* + Data producers, consumers, owners and stewards across R&D. These could include lab and computational scientists, clinicians, statisticians, pharmaceutical and regulatory affairs professionals.
  + Data architects, engineers, UI/UX engineers, product/platform/technology teams
  + AI and ML scientists, engineers etc.
  + Vendors and external contract staff
  + Relevant Industry forums / consortia in the data and information space.

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Data and AI Catalog Management (Pharma R&D Focus):Co-create and own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, rollout (resourcing, budgeting and delivery) and adoption (communication and metrics) of an R&D data and AI Model Catalog capability that aligns with the broader goals of the Pharmaceutical R&D team. This includes cross-domain search and discovery capabilities that enable scientists to find relevant data assets and reduce time to insight. Translate data cataloguing into business value by driving alignment between R&D data and AI model Catalog and key R&D business outcomes. Implement and manage specialized R&D data and AI Model catalog/s to maintain an inventory of a vast array of scientific data assets, from raw instrument outputs to curated datasets, data products, data models, AI models and services and governance policies.

* Partner with business and technical teams to create cohesive frameworks for access control, modeling, cross-domain discoverability, reusability for various analytics and AI use cases, and lifecycle management
* Enhance the catalog by ensuring integration with R&D systems, processes and AI services allowing scientists to quickly grasp the meaning, context, and reliability of data. Liaise with IT to troubleshoot technical issues, maintain server integrity, and integrations with other platforms and capabilities.
* Document and manage governance while taking into consideration the purpose and intended use of data, e.g. data sensitivity, privacy, GxP compliance, data lineage and data integrity. This is done in close collaboration with R&D Data Governance, Quality Assurance, Legal, Patents and Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, etc.
* Drive adoption and best practices across teams by providing tailored training on the use of the catalog for specific research needs. Monitor the usage and effectiveness of the data catalog.
* Establish feedback loops to capture unmet data needs and gaps in catalog coverage as well as improve data quality.
* Partner with business and technology teams responsible for business information modeling, business data architecture, master and reference data standards, other data and AI capabilities to enable seamless data operations across R&D

**Strategic Leadership**

* + Influence without authority
  + Operate collaboratively in a flat-hierarchy environment
  + Advocate data capabilities usage across diverse R&D functions.
  + Co-shape DSAI strategy for data and data science

**WHO YOU ARE**

* MS in Biological Sciences or MS Computer Science, Data Science, and Information Management preferably in a biomedical context.
* 10+ years in data catalog, metadata management and controlled vocabularies, related data and search capabilities in the biomedical domain. Product thinking would be a distinct bonus.
* Good understanding of pharmaceutical or life science R&D and the user base.
* Strong grasp of modern data governance and data quality, knowledge graphs, search/retrieval systems, AI and machine learning concepts, agentic workflows, DevOps, and modern data and AI stacks (e.g., AWS, Databricks, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Glue, SageMaker, MCP).
* Proven delivery of high-impact data and AI products/solutions for Pharma R&D - vision, approach, roadmap and delivery.
* Self-starter, independent yet collaborative, detail oriented, structured, process-oriented practitioner with reliable project management skills, able to influence a variety of stakeholders and manage ambiguity in a complex and changing environment.
* Strategic and conceptual thinker, effective communicator with a high learning agility, capable of translating across multiple domains and stakeholder archetypes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Shape the Future of Aerospace. Engineer What’s Next.**
--------------------------------------------------------

At **RTX**, the world’s largest aerospace and defense company, approximately 185,000 innovators come together with a shared purpose: solving the world’s most complex challenges and making a meaningful difference. Through our industry-leading businesses, advanced research, and cutting-edge technologies, we are redefining what’s possible in aerospace and defense.

**Collins Aerospace**, an RTX business, is at the forefront of developing intelligent, technologically advanced solutions that connect and protect our world. Our innovations help shape the future of flight, enhance aircraft capabilities, and enable safer, smarter, and more connected aviation systems.

Are you ready to work on software that powers the future of airborne communication?

We are looking for an experienced **Principal Engineer – Avionics Communication & Data Link Systems** to join our Airborne Information Solutions Department within the Communication, Navigation, and Surveillance (CNS) division. As part of the End-to-End Communication Team, you will contribute to the development, verification, integration, and certification of advanced avionics communication applications that support reliable, safety-critical airborne connectivity.

This is an opportunity to apply your software engineering expertise to complex aerospace challenges, work with industry-leading avionics standards, and help deliver mission-critical technologies that keep aircraft and the global aviation ecosystem connected.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As part of our avionics software engineering team, you will:

* **Design and develop advanced avionics software:** Contribute to the architecture, development, integration, and verification of airborne communication applications using C, C++, and Python.
* **Engineer next-generation data link solutions:** Develop and verify applications supporting Controller-Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC), Automatic Dependent Surveillance–Contract (ADS-C), ATN Context Management (CM), and FANS ACARS Facilities Notification (AFN).
* **Apply industry-leading aviation standards:** Implement and maintain compliance with relevant ARINC standards, including ARINC 429, 618, 620, 622, 661, 739, and 615.
* **Deliver certification-ready software:** Apply DO-178B/C processes and contribute to the development of high-integrity, safety-critical software that meets stringent aviation certification objectives.
* **Drive software quality and verification:** Perform requirements analysis, verification and validation (V&V), structural coverage analysis (SCA), debugging, troubleshooting, and unit, integration, white-box, and verification testing.
* **Enable seamless system integration:** Support software-software and hardware-software integration, identify complex system-level issues, and drive effective technical resolutions.
* **Support certification and compliance activities:** Prepare for and participate in Stages of Involvement (SOI), certification reviews, technical audits, and engagements with internal and external compliance authorities.
* **Collaborate across engineering disciplines:** Work closely with systems, software, integration, verification, and certification teams to deliver robust, reliable, and high-quality solutions.
* **Strengthen engineering excellence:** Contribute to requirements management, reliability analysis, risk mitigation, process optimization, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle.
* **Leverage advanced engineering tools:** Use network analyzers, simulation environments, and software development and verification tools to validate performance and troubleshoot complex avionics systems.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech/M.Tech), with a foundation in avionics systems and software architecture.
* **12+ years of avionics software development and verification experience.**
* Strong programming proficiency in C or C++ and Python.
* Solid understanding of avionics systems and architectures, including Data Link, Communication, Navigation and Surveillance (CNS), Flight Management Systems (FMS), Flight Control Systems (FCS), and aircraft displays.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), covering requirements analysis, software design, coding, integration, verification, and validation.
* Practical exposure to DO-178B/C processes and safety-critical software development.
* Hands-on experience with V&V, structural coverage analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, and white-box, unit, integration, and verification testing.
* Experience with software development and verification tools such as VectorCAST, PyATE, RapiTest, Git, and Subversion.
* Familiarity with real-time operating systems and network analyzer tools used for communication and performance testing.
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in an Agile engineering environment.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing, integrating, and certifying large-scale avionics software systems.
* Strong knowledge of safety-critical software architecture, design principles, and development practices.
* Practical experience with airborne communication and data link protocols, including applicable ARINC standards.
* Familiarity with avionics simulation environments and system-level testing.
* Experience supporting formal certification reviews, SOI activities, compliance audits, and certification evidence preparation.
* Ability to analyze complex technical problems, collaborate across engineering disciplines, and drive issues through to resolution.

**What You’ll Gain**
--------------------

At Collins Aerospace, your work contributes to technologies that have a direct impact on the future of aviation.

* **Meaningful engineering challenges:** Work on advanced avionics communication applications that support aircraft connectivity and operational safety.
* **Technical depth and innovation:** Apply your expertise in embedded software, data link protocols, real-time systems, and safety-critical engineering.
* **End-to-end product exposure:** Participate across the software lifecycle, from requirements and design through verification, integration, and certification.
* **Collaborative engineering:** Partner with experienced professionals across software, systems, integration, and certification disciplines.
* **Continuous improvement:** Contribute ideas that strengthen engineering processes, software quality, and technical excellence.

**Why Join Collins Aerospace?**

Collins Aerospace, a **Raytheon Technologies company**, is a global leader in advanced aerospace and defense solutions. Our Avionics business delivers trusted navigation, communication, surveillance, and safety systems used worldwide.

At Collins Aerospace, you will:

* Work alongside **industry-leading experts**
* Build technologies that **protect lives and enable safer aviation**
* Grow your career while shaping the **future of aerospace innovation**

We are redefining aerospace—and you can be part of it.

**Work Model Options**

* **Hybrid:** A mix of onsite and remote work

Collaboration and innovation are core to our culture, supported by world-class digital tools and global connectivity.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
**Staff Engineer**  
**Location**: Hyderabad, India  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time; Salaried  
**Compensation:** Base Salary, Bonus, Medical

Job Description
===============

### **About Us**

Innovapptive is a **category-defining SaaS company** building the world’s most advanced **AI-powered Connected Worker Platform** for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, Innovapptive is on a mission to **reimagine how industrial work gets done** — connecting frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.

Our platform is trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises — including **Shell, Hess, Cenovus Energy, W.R.Grace, Westlake Chemicals, UNICEF, Kimberly Clark, Scott Miracle Gro, and Newmont Mining** to name a few, and across chemicals, energy, mining, and manufacturing industries. These enterprises have achieved tangible, hard-dollar results, such as:

* Over **$40 million in annual EBITDA savings** at a single enterprise.
* **10× frontline productivity improvements** through mobile-first and AI-enabled workflows.
* **15–20% maintenance cost reductions** and **significant uptime gains** across plants and sites.

Innovapptive is recognized by leading industry analysts for its differentiated value creation model:

* Named a **Leader in the Frost & Sullivan Industrial Connected Worker Radar.**
* Featured by **Gartner** in “Connected Factory Worker” research and the **Hype Cycle for Manufacturing Operations Strategy.**
* Cited by **LNS Research** for delivering **3–5× greater value** than point solutions through unified OT–IT execution, AI/vision innovation, and field-proven ROI.

Our growth is backed by **Tiger Global Management and Vista Equity Partners**, one of the world’s premier software investors, known for scaling high-performance SaaS companies. Together, we are building the next-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.

Today, with over **300+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ**, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to **$100M ARR within the next 3-4 years** by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.

### **The Opportunity**

When a technician in a refinery, a mine, or a chemical plant opens one of our apps, they are trusting that it works, every time, on a shift where the stakes are real. As a **Staff Engineer**, you are one of the people who earns that trust.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will not manage a team on an org chart. You will lead through the quality of your designs, the depth of your code, and the engineers you make better. You will own the technical direction of major areas of our Mobile and Web platform, set the engineering bar for the teams around you, and turn ambiguous business problems into simple, scalable, dependable solutions.

You will work across our product suite and across the stack, from Node.js microservices and data models to Angular/React and React Native experiences, on AWS. You will also help us bring AI-enabled capabilities into products that frontline workers use every day.

We believe quality depends on the people making the design decisions. At Staff level, you own the "-ilities": scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability. You build them into the design instead of testing them afterwards.

### **How You Will Make An Impact**

* **Own architecture and design.** Lead the design of complex, cross-team features and platform capabilities. Write clear HLDs and LLDs, drive design reviews, and make the trade-offs explicit.
* **Build what matters, hands-on.** Write production-grade code in Node.js, MongoDB/DynamoDB, and Angular or React (including React Native) for the hardest, highest-impact problems. You lead from the code.
* **Design APIs and microservices that last.** Define RESTful and OData API contracts, service boundaries, and data models that scale across customers, industries, and SAP and IBM Maximo integrations.
* **Raise the engineering bar.** Set standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and documentation. Use tools like SonarQube and strong unit and integration testing so that quality is measurable.
* **Be the multiplier.** Mentor Senior Engineers and Leads, grow future architects, and make every design and code review a teaching moment.
* **Drive reliability and performance.** Own the non-functional requirements of your area. Lead root-cause analysis on complex production issues and fix the system, not just the symptom.
* **Deploy with confidence.** Shape how we ship on AWS (and Azure/GCP where needed) with Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices.
* **Partner across the company.** Work closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, UX designers, QE, and Engineering leadership on vision, planning, and high-level estimates. Join customer conversations when a hard problem needs the right answer.
* **Shape our AI-enabled future.** Help integrate AI services into our products responsibly, and bring a pragmatic view of what works in industrial environments.
* **Stay curious.** Evaluate emerging technologies and bring the ones that make our products and our teams better.

**What You Bring to the Team:**

**Key Qualifications**
----------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* **10–12 years** of full stack engineering experience, with a track record of delivering multiple major releases of SaaS products.
* Deep expertise in **Node.js** and **MongoDB / DynamoDB**, including data modelling and performance optimization.
* Strong proficiency in **Angular or React**; experience with **React Native** or mobile (hybrid/native) applications is a strong plus.
* Proven experience designing **RESTful / OData APIs and microservices architectures** at scale.
* Hands-on experience with **AWS** (Azure/GCP a plus), **Docker and Kubernetes**, and setting up or driving **CI/CD**.
* A history of technical leadership: leading designs, mentoring engineers, and influencing without authority.
* A quality mindset: unit testing, code quality tooling (e.g., SonarQube), security, observability, and performance as part of everyday engineering.
* Excellent communication. You can write a crisp design doc (HLD/LLD/SDD) and explain a complex trade-off to an engineer, a product manager, or a customer.
* Experience in an agile environment.
* **Good to have:** integration experience with SAP or IBM Maximo; Realm and AWS Amplify; third-party integrations (Instabug, Mixpanel, payment gateways); exposure to AI/GenAI-enabled product features; background in industrial, ERP, or enterprise SaaS.
* A valid passport, as occasional customer travel may be needed.
* If you meet most of this and are excited by the problem, we encourage you to apply. We hire for ownership and curiosity.

### **Why Join Us**

* Be the **architect of reliability and adoption** for the world’s leading industrial brands.
* Influence how industrial SaaS is designed, delivered, and scaled globally.
* Collaborate with top minds in maintenance, operations, and technology.
* Work in a culture that values **initiative, ownership, and measurable impact**.
* Competitive compensation, performance-linked rewards, and comprehensive benefits.

**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We're looking for an organised, proactive Infrastructure Delivery Coordinator to join our Service Management team in Hyderabad.

You'll make sure infrastructure projects are delivered on time, on budget and to customer commitments. * Work with engineers and technical teams to make sure every change is tested, resilient and handed over cleanly

* Keep delivery on track by managing risks, issues and dependencies, and escalating where needed

* Keep customers and stakeholders updated, and close projects out properly

**Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Experience coordinating delivery of IT infrastructure projects, such as network, cloud, data-centre or hardware projects

* A broad understanding of infrastructure technologies, with the confidence to work closely with technical specialists

* Experience managing suppliers, service providers or third-party contractors

* Familiarity with JSM or similar IT Service Management (ITSM) tooling

* Strong planning and organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several priorities at once

* Clear written and spoken communication, with confidence working with customers, engineers and commercial teams

* Experience with data-centre, co-location or hardware lifecycle management

* Knowledge of Microsoft SPLA or other software licence reporting

* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure

**Why join us**

* Play a central role in the operations that keep a global automotive technology platform running

* Build broad delivery experience across infrastructure, cloud, commercial and supplier management

* Work every day with colleagues in the UK and India

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Innovapptive is a **category-defining SaaS company** building the world’s most advanced **AI-powered Connected Worker Platform** for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, Innovapptive is on a mission to **reimagine how industrial work gets done** — connecting frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.

Our platform is trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises — including **Shell, Hess, Cenovus Energy, W.R.Grace, Westlake Chemicals, UNICEF, Kimberly Clark, Scott Miracle Gro, and Newmont Mining** to name a few, and across chemicals, energy, mining, and manufacturing industries. These enterprises have achieved tangible, hard-dollar results, such as:

* Over **$40 million in annual EBITDA savings** at a single enterprise.
* **10× frontline productivity improvements** through mobile-first and AI-enabled workflows.
* **15–20% maintenance cost reductions** and **significant uptime gains** across plants and sites.

Innovapptive is recognized by leading industry analysts for its differentiated value creation model:

* Named a **Leader in the Frost & Sullivan Industrial Connected Worker Radar.**
* Featured by **Gartner** in “Connected Factory Worker” research and the **Hype Cycle for Manufacturing Operations Strategy.**
* Cited by **LNS Research** for delivering **3–5× greater value** than point solutions through unified OT–IT execution, AI/vision innovation, and field-proven ROI.

Today, with over **300+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ**, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to **$100M ARR within the next 3-4 years** by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is Innovapptive's technical team embedded directly with customers. You'll be the technical thread on your accounts from the first conversation through production, not a pre-sales-only resource.

* 10+ years in enterprise architecture, solutions architecture, or technical pre-sales for complex B2B/enterprise software
* Deep experience with integration architecture — APIs, middleware, data pipelines — and enterprise systems such as SAP or IBM Maximo
* Working knowledge of identity, security, and network architecture in enterprise and cloud environments
* Comfortable owning technical decisions directly with customer architects and IT leadership
* Experience staying engaged with an account beyond the sales cycle — through deployment and stabilization

* Experience with industrial or asset-intensive customers (manufacturing, utilities, oil & gas, EAM)
* Familiarity with mobile and offline-first application architecture

* Exceptional health, vision, and dental care
* A positive, open, and highly-innovative environment and team.
* Entrepreneurial spirit with unlimited opportunity to grow.
* Opportunity to work with leading global brands on exciting and impactful projects.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are a fast-growing technology startup preparing new products for production. We're looking for a hands-on **Database Platform Engineer** to own our PostgreSQL databases on AWS end to end: keeping them fast, reliable and secure at high concurrency, building the data pipelines that feed them, and automating how they are deployed and changed. You'll work closely with our principal engineer and backend team, and your decisions will shape the platform as it scales.

Key responsibilities

**Database administration**

* Own PostgreSQL on AWS RDS / Aurora in production, including high availability, replication and failover.
* Design and test backup and point-in-time recovery to meet defined RPO and RTO targets.
* Tune performance using execution plans, pg\_stat\_statements and Performance Insights; manage indexes, partitions, vacuum and bloat.
* Configure RDS parameter groups and connection pooling (PgBouncer / RDS Proxy) for high-concurrency workloads.
* Plan and run zero-downtime schema changes, data migrations and major version upgrades.
* Review database designs from developers for performance, integrity and security.

**Data engineering**

* Build and maintain data pipelines (ETL/ELT, CDC) using Python, SQL and AWS services.

* Set up monitoring, alerting and dashboards with CloudWatch and Grafana; lead incident response and root-cause analysis.

Must-have skills

* 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration in production, including databases of 1 TB or more.
