title: Delivery Director
description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

We're looking for a Delivery Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation: a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and still growing. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance role sitting apart from the work. You'll take direct ownership of how delivery runs day to day, build a high-performing team, and set the tone for its spirit.

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM, who hold technical direction for their respective practices. As the most senior Two Circles leader in Hyderabad, you'll also play an important role in our work with BCCI, our most important partner in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and Engineering Excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong spirit in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team's health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**

Proven experience building, scaling and leading complex delivery organisations at scale (50+ people) spanning engineering, QA and delivery, including experience managing managers.

* A delivery and operator mindset first. Genuine fluency across data and digital product engineering, sufficient to work credibly with Tech Leads and architects on trade-offs, quality and risk, without requiring a hands-on engineering background yourself.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, across technical, commercial and client audiences.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Eligible to work in India.

Nice to Have

* A formal delivery or PMO background, or certification (Scrum, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

Location and Travel

Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate to Hyderabad.

Able to travel to Vancouver, London, and Melbourne twice a year.

Your day will involve working closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to translate business needs into **scalable, resilient, and secure system designs**. You will lead architecture discussions, review designs and code, define API contracts, and ensure alignment across multiple engineering teams.


You will play a key role in modernizing legacy systems into **cloud\-native, microservices\-based, and event\-driven architectures**, ensuring high availability, performance, and extensibility. You will also guide teams on adopting best practices around **observability, fault tolerance, and CI/CD pipelines**.


A significant portion of your time will be spent mentoring engineers, influencing technical decisions, and ensuring consistency across platform architecture, while balancing immediate delivery needs with long\-term strategic goals.

o Reservations and booking orchestration

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

title: M365 End User Computing Architect
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**
-----------------


The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and evolution of the organization's end user technology ecosystem. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for the Microsoft 365 platform and related productivity, collaboration, and security services — driving adoption, standardization, and innovation across the enterprise.


The EUC Architect partners closely with business stakeholders, IT operations teams, security, and enterprise architecture to ensure the end user environment is modern, resilient, and aligned with organizational objectives. This individual operates at both the strategic and hands\-on technical level, owning architectural decisions from concept through implementation.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own the end\-to\-end architectural vision and roadmap for the Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, and the broader M365 suite
* Define and enforce tenant configuration standards, governance policies, and design patterns across all M365 workloads
* Lead architectural decisions for Microsoft Copilot adoption, including readiness assessments, data governance prerequisites, and rollout strategy
* Design and maintain identity and access architecture in partnership with the IAM team, including Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and hybrid identity models
* Architect Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager solutions for device management, compliance policies, application delivery, and Autopilot provisioning
* Establish architecture for Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, eDiscovery, Compliance Manager) and advise on data governance posture
* Drive the strategy for Microsoft Viva, Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), and low\-code/no\-code citizen development governance

**End User Computing Strategy**
-------------------------------

* Define the long\-term EUC strategy spanning physical endpoints (Windows, macOS), virtual desktop infrastructure (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365\), and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) via Microsoft Intune
* Lead endpoint lifecycle architecture including OS imaging, patching strategy, hardware standards, and Windows 11 migration planning
* Architect solutions for remote and hybrid work scenarios, ensuring performance, security, and user experience parity regardless of location
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and communicate business value and architectural impact to leadership

**Governance \& Standards**
---------------------------

* Develop and maintain EUC architecture standards, reference architectures, and design documentation
* Establish M365 governance frameworks including tenant policies, external sharing controls, Teams provisioning governance, and data residency requirements
* Define and socialize naming conventions, RBAC models, licensing optimization strategies, and change management processes
* Conduct architecture reviews for EUC\-impacting projects and provide design authority sign\-off

**Security \& Compliance**
--------------------------

* Partner with the Information Security team to integrate Zero Trust principles throughout the EUC environment
* Architect solutions leveraging Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and the broader Microsoft Defender XDR suite
* Ensure EUC architecture aligns with regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, FINRA, GDPR) as applicable to the business

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on EUC and M365 capabilities, roadmap, and investment priorities
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, networking, and application teams to ensure integrated, cohesive solutions
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to EUC engineers and administrators
* Represent EUC architecture in governance forums, architecture review boards, and vendor engagements
* Partner with Microsoft account teams and FastTrack resources to leverage available programs and stay ahead of platform changes

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in an architecture or senior engineering role focused on end user computing or Microsoft 365\.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across the core Microsoft 365 workloads:


	+ **Collaboration \& Productivity:** Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Viva
	+ **Identity \& Access:** Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, MFA, Privileged Identity Management
	+ **Device Management:** Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Windows Autopilot
	+ **Security:** Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365
	+ **Compliance:** Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, eDiscovery
	+ **Automation \& Platform:** Power Platform, Microsoft Graph API
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing M365 tenant architecture in large, complex enterprise environments
* Strong understanding of hybrid identity models, Azure AD Connect, and cloud\-only identity scenarios
* Experience with virtual desktop technologies (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms and their integration with M365 tooling (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Strong documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, reference designs, and decision records

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* **Technical Depth:** Expert\-level command of M365 platform capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns
* **Strategic Vision:** Ability to translate business requirements into a coherent, future\-state EUC architecture
* **Communication:** Clear and compelling communicator to both technical and executive audiences
* **Problem Solving:** Structured thinker who can diagnose complex, cross\-domain issues and drive resolution
* **Collaboration:** Builds trust across teams; effective in cross\-functional and matrixed environments
* **Governance Mindset:** Proactively establishes guardrails and standards without creating unnecessary friction

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Microsoft certifications, including one or more of:


	+ Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert
	+ Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
	+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot for M365 deployment planning and AI\-readiness assessments
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and their application in enterprise EUC environments
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.)
* Background in enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman)

* Develop production\-grade automation for network provisioning, configuration management, compliance validation, and remediation

**Collaboration \& Enablement**


* Partner with Network Architecture to embed automation into design standards and reference architectures

* Work with Cloud and DevOps teams to integrate network automation with broader infrastructure automation initiatives
* Mentor and upskill network engineers on automation principles, scripting, and platform usage

**Operational Excellence**


* Provide Level 3/4 escalation support for complex automation platform and workflow issues

* Implement monitoring and alerting for automation infrastructure and job execution
* Conduct regular platform health assessments and optimization activities
**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent professional experience)

* 3\+ years of demonstrated experience designing and implementing network automation solutions at scale
* Proven track record of greenfield automation platform implementation and organizational adoption

**Core Automation \& Orchestration:**


* Expert\-level proficiency with Ansible (Tower/AWX experience strongly preferred)
* Advanced skills in Python for network automation (libraries: Netmiko, NAPALM, Nornir, TextFSM)

* Practical knowledge of CI/CD platforms (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Experience with source of truth platforms (NetBox, Nautobot, or similar)


**Network Technologies:**


* Deep understanding of enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, STP, VLANs, VRFs)

* Analyze master data trends, identify anomalies, and recommend corrective actions.
* Participate in system testing, UAT, and release validation activities.

### **Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with business users, commercial teams, data engineers, and application owners to understand data requirements.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

### **Must\-Have**

* 5\-8 years of experience in **Master Data Management and Data Stewardship**.
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
	+ **Reltio MDM**
	+ **Informatica MDM**
* Strong understanding of:
	+ Data Governance
	+ Data Quality Management
	+ Data Stewardship processes
	+ Match/Merge and Survivorship concepts
	+ Hierarchy and Reference Data Management
* Advanced SQL querying and data analysis skills.
* Python scripting experience for automation and data processing.

* Knowledge of Data Change Request (DCR) workflows and governance processes.
* Strong understanding of customer master data concepts (HCP, HCO, Affiliations, etc.).

* Participate in vulnerability remediation, security assessments, and compliance activities.
* Build automation solutions to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and minimize operational risk.
* Participate in project planning, technical discussions, and cross\-functional initiatives involving cloud collaboration and secure file transfer technologies.
* Work closely with vendors and internal engineering teams to evaluate new features, enhancements, and emerging technologies.

* Knowledge of Trusted eShare or similar enterprise secure collaboration platforms.
* Good understanding of Secure File Transfer technologies including SFTP, FTP, SSH, HTTPS, APIs, and related protocols.

* Understanding of cloud and SaaS platforms such as Microsoft 365, AWS, Azure, Salesforce, Box, or similar technologies.
* Good understanding of Linux and Windows operating systems.
* Knowledge of enterprise data protection concepts including DLP, secure collaboration, and information protection technologies.
* Familiarity with authentication and authorization concepts including SSO, MFA, OAuth, and certificate\-based authentication.
* Understanding of secure data flows across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications:**
 Bachelor’s degree and 5 to 9 years of experience
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Comfort with scripting (PowerShell, Python, etc) and expression development (SQL, Regex)
* Ability to develop documentation for Infrastructure Security implementations
* Basic experience with ITIL processes such as Incident, Problem, and configuration management
* Experience in complex enterprise environments with competing business priorities


**Professional Certifications (please mention if the certification is preferred or mandatory for the role):**
* Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP) or Security\+
* SANS Certifications
* Relevant vendor\-specific certifications


**Soft Skills:**
* Established analytical and gap/fit assessment skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams
* High degree of initiative and self\-motivation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
* Team\-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals
* Effective presentation and public speaking skills.


**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
   

  

 In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

title: Data engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Associate Data Engineer to join our growing data team. This entry\-level role is ideal for a recent graduate or early\-career professional with a strong foundation in data principles and a passion for building robust data pipelines. The successful candidate will be expected to quickly ramp up and contribute at a level comparable to someone with a year of professional experience, focusing on developing and maintaining data infrastructure, handling diverse data types including unstructured data, and ensuring data quality and accessibility.

Roles \& Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient data pipelines using various ETL/ELT tools and techniques.
* Ingest, transform, and load diverse datasets, including structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data, from various sources.
* Implement robust data quality checks and monitoring mechanisms to ensure data integrity and reliability.
* Collaborate with Data Scientists, Analysts, and other engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
* Optimize data storage and processing for performance and cost\-efficiency.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues in data pipelines and data systems.
* Stay updated with emerging data engineering technologies and best practices, contributing to continuous improvement.

Required Skills

* Strong proficiency in at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (e.g., Python, Java, Scala).
* Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
* Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and ETL/ELT processes.
* Basic understanding of handling unstructured data (e.g., using NoSQL databases like MongoDB, Cassandra, or object storage like AWS S3, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage).
* Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software development best practices.
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and analytical thinking.
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
* Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Skills

* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their data services (e.g., S3, Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).
* Familiarity with big data technologies (e.g., Apache Spark, Hadoop).
* Experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Luigi).
* Understanding of data streaming concepts (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis).
* Basic understanding of containerization (e.g., Docker).

Benefits

* Comprehensive health Insurance
* Professional development opportunities and tuition reimbursement
* Wellness programs
* Flexible work arrangements
* Collaborative and inclusive company culture

title: Anaplan Data Engineer
description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

  

We are seeking a Data Engineer with strong Anaplan and enterprise data integration experience to design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions supporting connected planning, analytics, and business decision\-making.


This role will be responsible for integrating data from multiple enterprise systems into Anaplan, improving data quality and automation, and partnering with business and technical teams to deliver reliable planning solutions. The ideal candidate combines hands\-on data engineering expertise with a strong understanding of Anaplan architecture, model data flows, and planning processes.


Key Responsibilities

* Design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines between Anaplan and enterprise source systems.
* Develop integrations using Anaplan CloudWorks, Anaplan Connect, REST APIs, ETL or ELT platforms, and cloud data services.
* Extract, transform, validate, and load data from systems such as ERP, CRM, HRIS, data warehouses, data lakes, and flat\-file sources.
* Partner with Anaplan model builders and solution architects to define efficient data structures, import processes, mappings, and integration patterns.
* Create and maintain data transformation logic, staging layers, reconciliation processes, and exception\-handling workflows.
* Monitor data pipelines and resolve integration failures, data\-quality issues, and performance bottlenecks.
* Develop reusable integration components, technical standards, and automation frameworks.
* Support Anaplan model lifecycle activities, including data refreshes, production deployments, model copies, and environment management.
* Ensure data integrations comply with security, access\-control, audit, and governance requirements.
* Document data flows, source\-to\-target mappings, technical designs, operating procedures, and support processes.
* Collaborate with finance, supply chain, sales, workforce planning, and other business teams to understand data requirements.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and implement long\-term solutions for recurring data and integration issues.
* Support testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, reconciliation, and user acceptance testing.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, and improve the reliability of planning data.
* Provide operational support for business\-critical Anaplan integrations and scheduled data processes.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* Three or more years of experience in data engineering, data integration, business intelligence, or enterprise application integration.
* Hands\-on experience working with Anaplan data integrations and model data processes.
* Experience with Anaplan CloudWorks, Anaplan Connect, APIs, or similar integration technologies.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases, data warehouses, or cloud data platforms.
* Experience building ETL or ELT pipelines using tools such as Informatica, Boomi, MuleSoft, SnapLogic, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Matillion, Talend, dbt, or similar platforms.
* Experience working with structured data formats such as CSV, JSON, XML, and API payloads.
* Strong understanding of data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and error handling.
* Ability to troubleshoot data discrepancies and integration failures across multiple systems.
* Experience with version control, deployment processes, and development lifecycle practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

* Anaplan Level 1, Level 2, Model Builder, Solution Architect, or related certification.
* Experience with Anaplan Data Orchestrator.
* Experience developing or supporting Anaplan models.
* Familiarity with Anaplan Application Lifecycle Management and production deployment practices.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or Snowflake.
* Programming or scripting experience with Python, PowerShell, Shell scripting, Java, or similar languages.
* Experience with enterprise planning processes such as financial planning, sales planning, workforce planning, demand planning, or supply chain planning.
* Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, master data management, and data\-security practices.
* Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery environments.
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, alerting, and workload\-scheduling tools.


Technical Skills

* Anaplan CloudWorks
* Anaplan Connect
* Anaplan REST APIs
* Anaplan Data Orchestrator
* SQL
* ETL and ELT development
* Data warehouses and data lakes
* Cloud integration platforms
* Python or scripting
* API integration
* Data mapping and transformation
* Data\-quality controls
* Job scheduling and monitoring
* Source control and deployment automation


Core Competencies

* Data engineering and integration design
* Anaplan architecture awareness
* Technical troubleshooting
* Data\-quality management
* Process automation
* Stakeholder collaboration
* Solution documentation
* Attention to detail
* Ownership and accountability
* Continuous improvement

  

Success Measures


Success in this role will be measured by:

* Reliability and timeliness of Anaplan data integrations.
* Reduction in manual data preparation and upload activities.
* Accuracy and completeness of planning data.
* Speed of issue resolution and reduction in recurring failures.
* Performance and scalability of data pipelines.
* Adoption of reusable integration standards and automation.
* Stakeholder satisfaction with data availability and quality.


Reporting Relationship


This role will typically report to the Data Engineering Manager, Enterprise Applications Manager, Anaplan Product Owner, or Director of Business Systems and will work closely with Anaplan architects, model builders, data platform teams, and business process owners.
